adrift.name: Adrift
description: ::trait{title="&L&Adrift&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›" flavor="You never felt like you belonged in your family. You were different, an outsider, and you grew up unable to bond with the people around you. Now, as an adult, you are still a little odd and others have a hard time understanding what makes you tick." benefit="You receive a +1 trait bonus on saving throws made to resist charm and compulsion effects."}

celestial_community.name: Celestial Community
description: ::trait{title="&L&Celestial Community&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›" flavor="Having been raised among other aasimars, you have a stronger connection to your planar heritage than most of your kind, and have more thoroughly explored your magical talent." benefit="You may expend your once-per-day spell-like ability to spontaneously cast ‹spell/cure light wounds› (CL equal to your character level), but doing so is draining and you take an amount of nonlethal damage equal to half the number of hit points you heal."}

celestial_contact.name: Celestial Contact
description: ::trait{title="&L&Celestial Contact&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›" flavor="Witnessing a celestial intervention by your ancestor or a similar being inspired you with the power of good." benefit="Treat your caster level as 1 higher when you cast spells with the good descriptor."}

clergy_member.name: Clergy Member
description: ::trait{title="&L&Clergy Member&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›" flavor="You belong to a particular faith, and your religious leaders see you as a mortal aspect of their deity. You are treated with respect and graciousness whenever you visit a temple of your faith." benefit="You receive a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks when interacting with ordained members of your religion, and once per week you can request aid from a temple of your faith. The GM has final say in what sort of aid you can reasonably request, but in general you may ask for the casting of a 1st-level spell or for a nonmagical item worth 50 gp or less."}

ethical_leader.name: Ethical Leader
description: ::trait{title="&L&Ethical Leader&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›" flavor="You attract followers who agree with your philosophical outlook on life. Your followers and cohorts are more willing to serve you because of their confidence in your strong moral position." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus to your ‹feat/Leadership› score if all your cohorts and followers have an alignment within one step of your alignment."}

faith_healer.name: Faith Healer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Faith Healer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›" flavor="You have an unearthly appearance and soothing aura about you that make people believe you are gifted with divine powers. You learned at a young age to make use of your gift in order to make money, and you've found ways to ethically justify your work." benefit="You can make a ‹skill/Heal› check weekly to earn money as though making a ‹skill/Profession› check. In addition, you gain a +1 trait bonus on Heal checks."}

idealized_campaigner.name: Idealized Campaigner
description: ::trait{title="&L&Idealized Campaigner&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›" flavor="Your celestial bloodline leads others to idealize you from afar." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on all Charisma-based skill checks to interact with good-aligned creatures who have never met you before."}

innocent.name: Innocent
description: ::trait{title="&L&Innocent&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›" flavor="No one can believe someone as pure as you could be deceptive in any way. You have an air of innocence about you, and people have a hard time believing you could ever do anyone harm." benefit="When you make a ‹skill/Bluff› check to tell a lie, your target always wants to believe you, granting you the standard +5 bonus on your Bluff check. This bonus only applies if the lie you tell is either believable or unlikely."}

martyrs_blood.name: Martyr's Blood
description: ::trait{title="&L&Martyr's Blood&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›" flavor="You carry the blood of a self-sacrificing celestial, and strive to live up to your potential for heroism." benefit="As long as your current hit point total is less than half of your maximum hit points possible, you gain a +1 trait bonus on attack rolls against evil foes."}

planar_negotiator_boa.name: Planar Negotiator (BoA)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Planar Negotiator (BoA)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›" flavor="You are skilled at convincing outsiders that you require their aid." benefit="Whenever you cast ‹spell/lesser planar ally›, ‹spell/planar ally›, or ‹spell/greater planar ally›, you receive a 10% discount on the monetary cost required by the summoned outsiders. This bonus has no effect on services the outsiders may demand in order to strike a bargain."}

selective_health.name: Selective Health
description: ::trait{title="&L&Selective Health&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›" flavor="You are resistant to most illnesses that strike those around you, but vulnerable to the contagions of evil." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on Fortitude saves against diseases. However, whenever you must make a Fortitude saving throw against a disease inflicted by an undead creature or evil outsider (such as ‹curse/mummy rot› or a ‹monster/vrock«'s› spores), you do not gain this bonus, and instead take a -2 penalty on your Fortitude save."}

wary_boa.name: Wary (BoA)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Wary (BoA)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›" flavor="You grew up around people who were jealous of and hostile toward you. Perhaps your parents were not pleased to have a child touched by the divine - they may have berated or beaten you, or even sold you into slavery for an exorbitant price. You grew up mistrustful of others and believing your unique appearance to be a curse." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Disguise› and ‹skill/Sense Motive› checks."}

celestial_tracker.name: Celestial Tracker
description: ::trait{title="&L&Celestial Tracker&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›; Angelkin" flavor="You share the same talent for tracking evildoers that your angelic ancestor possessed." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Survival› checks made to follow tracks. In addition, you treat trails as being up to 24 hours fresher than they actually are when using the Survival skill to follow tracks."}

planetars_visions.name: Planetar's Visions
description: ::trait{title="&L&Planetar's Visions&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›; Angelkin" flavor="Ever since you were a child, you've experienced vivid dreams of cutting down hordes of shrieking, twisted demons." benefit="Whenever you succeed at a critical hit with a melee weapon against an evil outsider, you ignore an amount of the outsider's damage reduction (if any) equal to the critical multiplier of your weapon (this cannot reduce a creature's damage reduction to below 0)."}

burnished_skin.name: Burnished Skin
description: ::trait{title="&L&Burnished Skin&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›; Emberkin" benefit="Sometime during your adolescence, you suffered severe burns in a devastating fire. Along with your scars, you developed the uncanny ability to tell what is and isn't real, gaining a +2 trait bonus on saving throws made to disbelieve illusions."}

pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Pyromancer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›; Emberkin" flavor="You're especially adept at casting flame-based spells." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on damage rolls for any spell you cast with the fire descriptor. Spells that do not deal damage do not benefit from this trait."}

enlightened_warrior.name: Enlightened Warrior
description: ::trait{title="&L&Enlightened Warrior&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›; Idyllkin" flavor="You have always found it easy to maintain inner peace and enlightenment that translate well to the battlefield." benefit="You may take levels in ‹class/monk› even while maintaining a neutral or neutral good alignment."}

speech_of_the_wilds.name: Speech of the Wilds
description: ::trait{title="&L&Speech of the Wilds&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›; Idyllkin" flavor="Like your ‹family/agathion› ancestor, you have a knack for communicating with other creatures, and you are adept at breaking down language barriers." benefit="You can speak one extra ‹misc/language<s›."}

good_influence.name: Good Influence
description: ::trait{title="&L&Good Influence&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›; Lawbringer" flavor="You possess an innate ability to motivate and inspire others to do the right thing." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks when attempting to persuade a nongood creature to make a decision that benefits the cause of good, and when persuading a nonlawful creature to make a decision in line with the laws of the region. These bonuses stack if you attempt to persuade a nongood, nonlawful creature to take a lawful good action."}

lantern_spirit.name: Lantern Spirit
description: ::trait{title="&L&Lantern Spirit&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›; Lawbringer" flavor="Your celestial ancestor was a ‹monster/lantern archon› for centuries before ascending to a higher rank." benefit="You feel a strange sense of nostalgia whenever you use your ‹spell/continual flame› spell-like ability, and can use it as a @HLmove_action instead of a standard action."}

bralanis_step.name: Bralani's Step
description: ::trait{title="&L&Bralani's Step&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›; Musetouched" flavor="Your ancestor was a ‹monster/bralani›, an azata known for its untamed speed in battle. When in combat, you feel a fierce surge of energy through your limbs." benefit="Once per day, you may move an additional 5 feet as part of a move action."}

lillends_harp.name: Lillend's Harp
description: ::trait{title="&L&Lillend's Harp&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›; Musetouched" flavor="Your ancestor was a ‹monster/lillend›, a being of exceptional grace and singular musical talent." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Perform› (string) checks. This bonus increases to +2 when you make a Perform check as part of a ‹ability/bardic performance›."}

snake_hater.name: Snake Hater
description: ::trait{title="&L&Snake Hater&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›; Plumekith" flavor="You've always loathed serpents and other slithering monsters, ever since you can remember, and have studied them extensively." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (dungeoneering)› checks and Knowledge (dungeoneering) is always a class skill for you."}

toxophilite.name: Toxophilite
description: ::trait{title="&L&Toxophilite&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Aasimar›; Plumekith" benefit="You've inherited some of your celestial ancestor's prowess with the bow, and gain a +2 trait bonus on attack rolls made to confirm critical hits with bows."}

blood_algorithm.name: Blood Algorithm
description: ::trait{title="&L&Blood Algorithm&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Android›" flavor="Your inhumanity extends to your very core." benefit="Pain receptors were omitted during your construction, so you gain a +2 trait bonus on saving throws against spells with the pain descriptor. Additionally, once per day when you are healed by a spell that targets constructs (such as a ‹spell/make whole› spell), you heal 1 extra hit point per level of the spell."}

cellular_match.name: Cellular Match
description: ::trait{title="&L&Cellular Match&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Android›" benefit="Whenever you are affected by a polymorph spell or effect, your nanites adjust completely at a molecular level. For the duration of the polymorph effect, you are treated as only a humanoid for the purpose of effects that target creatures by type. For example, a ranger's ‹ability/favored enemy› bonus against constructs wouldn't apply to you while you are polymorphed, but nor would spells such as ‹spell/make whole›. This trait modifies part of the android's *constructed* racial trait, but otherwise that trait is unchanged (a polymorphed android still can't gain morale bonuses, is still immune to fear, and so on)."}

experimental_escapee.name: Experimental Escapee
description: ::trait{title="&L&Experimental Escapee&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Android›" flavor="You escaped an organization interested in finding out how your body works." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Escape Artist› and Strength checks to break free of bonds, grapples, and the like."}

nanite_revival.name: Nanite Revival
description: ::trait{title="&L&Nanite Revival&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Android›" flavor="You can instinctively activate your nanites to save your life." benefit="Once per day as an @HLimmediate_action, you can command your nanites to stabilize you while you are ‹misc/dying›, even while unconscious or helpless. This does not count as a use of your *nanite surge* ability."}

canopy_prowler.name: Canopy Prowler
description: ::trait{title="&L&Canopy Prowler&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Catfolk›" flavor="Growing up in the Mwangi Expanse, you learned to hunt from above, where your prey seldom searches for danger." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Climb› checks, and Climb is always a class skill for you. If you possess the *climber* racial trait, you also gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Stealth› checks while climbing."}

inquisitive_banterer.name: Inquisitive Banterer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Inquisitive Banterer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Catfolk›" flavor="You are able to learn information by bombarding others with questions that come across as conversational." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks. In addition, you can use Diplomacy to gather information in 1d2 hours instead of 1d4."}

jungle_opportunist.name: Jungle Opportunist
description: ::trait{title="&L&Jungle Opportunist&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Catfolk›" flavor="You trained with your clan to hunt large prey such as the dinosaurs of the Valashmai Jungle." benefit="When you grant an ally a bonus on an attack roll against a foe of Large or larger size due to ‹rule/flanking› or the ‹rule/aid another<_2› action, that ally gains a +1 trait bonus on weapon damage rolls against that creature as well."}

bitter_heart.name: Bitter Heart
description: ::trait{title="&L&Bitter Heart&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Changeling›" benefit="You share a sliver of your mother's supernatural hatred, gaining a +2 trait bonus to confirm critical hits."}

creative_manipulator.name: Creative Manipulator
description: ::trait{title="&L&Creative Manipulator&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Changeling›" benefit="Once per day, you may reroll a Charisma check you just made. You must take the result of the second roll, even if it is worse."}

creepy.name: Creepy
description: ::trait{title="&L&Creepy&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Changeling›" flavor="Your strange bearing unsettles others." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Intimidate› checks and Intimidate is a class skill for you. You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks when interacting with ‹family/hag«s›."}

cruel_child.name: Cruel Child
description: ::trait{title="&L&Cruel Child&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Changeling›" flavor="Your wicked bloodline shines through, manifesting as a sadistic bloodlust in battle." benefit="When you make a full-round attack with your claws, you gain a +1 trait bonus on the attack rolls."}

magic_in_the_blood.name: Magic in the Blood
description: ::trait{title="&L&Magic in the Blood&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Changeling›" flavor="You possess natural magical ability." benefit="Select one of the following spells: ‹spell/bleed›, ‹spell/create water›, ‹spell/dancing lights›, ‹spell/detect good›, ‹spell/ghost sound›, ‹spell/putrefy food and drink›. You can cast this spell three times per day as a spell-like ability."}

switched_at_birth.name: Switched at Birth
description: ::trait{title="&L&Switched at Birth&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Changeling›" flavor="You were traded for another child in infancy and remained unaware of your origin as a changeling until some recent tragedy revealed the truth. Now the guilt of knowing you live because another child met a horrible fate haunts you and drives you to push forward in that child's name." benefit="Once per day, you can attempt a Will saving throw in place of a Fortitude saving throw against a spell, effect, or condition."}

acknowledged_scion.name: Acknowledged Scion
description: ::trait{title="&L&Acknowledged Scion&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dhampir›" flavor="You grew up in Nidal, Geb, or another place where your undead lineage was considered a mark of power." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (nobility)› and ‹skill/Knowledge (religion)› checks. One of these skills (your choice) is a class skill for you."}

born_in_the_light.name: Born in the Light
description: ::trait{title="&L&Born in the Light&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dhampir›" flavor="The circumstance of your birth and upbringing left little room to accommodate your weaknesses, and many hours toiling in broad daylight have decreased the severity of your innate hindrances." benefit="You gain a +2 bonus on checks and saves affected by the ‹feat/Endurance› feat (this bonus does not stack with the bonus granted by the Endurance feat). When your *light sensitivity* causes you to become ‹misc/dazzled›, you do not take the -1 penalty on sight-based ‹skill/Perception› checks."}

final_embrace.name: Final Embrace
description: ::trait{title="&L&Final Embrace&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dhampir›" flavor="Like your undead ancestor, you possess an intense yearning for the touch of the living, and the hunger that dwells within you grants an unnatural strength to your grip." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹rule/grapple› combat maneuver checks to pin an opponent."}

undead_slayer_bog.name: Undead Slayer (BoG)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Undead Slayer (BoG)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dhampir›" benefit="Filled with wrath against the monsters whose unclean blood makes you an outcast, you gain a +1 trait bonus on attack and damage rolls against undead creatures."}

half_forgotten_secrets.name: Half-Forgotten Secrets
description: ::trait{title="&L&Half-Forgotten Secrets&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dhampir›; Ajibachana" flavor="A whisper of knowledge was transferred to you at the time of your creation." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on checks with two ‹skill/Knowledge› skills of your choice, and one of these skills becomes a class skill."}

unidentifiable_appeal.name: Unidentifiable Appeal
description: ::trait{title="&L&Unidentifiable Appeal&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dhampir›; Ajibachana" flavor="The unnatural symmetry of your face gives you an attractiveness that is at once captivating but hard to quantify." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Disguise› checks and a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks made to influence those who would be attracted to you."}

old_before_your_time.name: Old Before Your Time
description: ::trait{title="&L&Old Before Your Time&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dhampir›; Ancient-born" flavor="Your fragile flesh shows signs of years not yet lived." benefit="Any creature trying to discern your true age must make a ‹skill/Perception› or ‹skill/Sense Motive› check opposed by your ‹skill/Bluff› check; you gain a +5 trait bonus on this check. You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Disguise› checks if your disguise makes you look at least one ‹rule/age« category› older, and ignore the check penalty for disguising yourself as a different age category while doing so."}

thrall_spotter.name: Thrall Spotter
description: ::trait{title="&L&Thrall Spotter&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dhampir›; Ancient-born" flavor="Your heritage gives you an understanding of the powers of domination." benefit="You gain a +5 trait bonus on ‹skill/Sense Motive› checks made to determine whether a creature is acting under the effects of a charm or compulsion."}

linguistic_genius.name: Linguistic Genius
description: ::trait{title="&L&Linguistic Genius&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dhampir›; Ru-shi" flavor="Words and letters say more to you than their writers ever intended." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Linguistics› checks, and learn to speak and read one additional language from your list of racial languages. Linguistics is always a class skill for you."}

numerological_gift.name: Numerological Gift
description: ::trait{title="&L&Numerological Gift&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dhampir›; Ru-shi" flavor="Since birth you have had an intimate connection with a certain number." benefit="When you select this trait, roll 3d6. The resulting number becomes your numerological totem and can never be changed. Once per day, when you roll your totem number on a d20 (such as an attack roll, save, or skill check), you may treat that roll as if you had rolled a natural 20 on the die."}

mind_trapper.name: Mind Trapper
description: ::trait{title="&L&Mind Trapper&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dhampir›; Svetocher" flavor="Your honeyed words are nearly impossible for your enchanted subjects to ignore." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on Charisma checks to convince an ally enchanted by one of your charm spells (such as ‹spell/charm person› or ‹spell/charm monster›) to do things it wouldn't normally do."}

sensual_graces.name: Sensual Graces
description: ::trait{title="&L&Sensual Graces&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dhampir›; Svetocher" flavor="Your unearthly beauty enchants those who court you." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› checks made against humanoids who would be attracted to you."}

arcane_prodigy.name: Arcane Prodigy
description: ::trait{title="&L&Arcane Prodigy&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Drow›" benefit="Once per day as an @HLimmediate_action, you can double the duration of one of your racial spell-like abilities, as if using the ‹feat/Extend Spell› metamagic feat."}

fleshwarp_exposure.name: Fleshwarp Exposure
description: ::trait{title="&L&Fleshwarp Exposure&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Drow›" flavor="Your body responds strongly to transmutations because you were exposed to fleshwarping magic." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against transmutation spells and effects. Transmutations you willingly accept affect you as though they were cast at 1 caster level higher for the purpose of determining duration."}

poisonous_upbringing.name: Poisonous Upbringing
description: ::trait{title="&L&Poisonous Upbringing&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Drow›" flavor="There were a few touchy moments in your education in the use of poisons." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on all saves to resist poison effects."}

scheming_survivor.name: Scheming Survivor
description: ::trait{title="&L&Scheming Survivor&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Drow›" flavor="You survived a close relative's betrayal only through quick wits and a strong stomach." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Sense Motive› checks and on saving throws against poison."}

vermin_driver.name: Vermin Driver
description: ::trait{title="&L&Vermin Driver&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Duergar›" benefit="You were instructed in the subtle magic of enslaving vermin, and can train mindless vermin with the ‹skill/Handle Animal› skill as if they were animals with an Intelligence score of 1."}

ancestral_grounds.name: Ancestral Grounds
description: ::trait{title="&L&Ancestral Grounds&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="You recall the dangers the dwarves faced during the Quest for Sky." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (dungeoneering)› checks and a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (history)› checks pertaining to the Quest for Sky. Select one of these skills to be a class skill for you."}

brewmaster.name: Brewmaster
description: ::trait{title="&L&Brewmaster&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="Your family brought the secrets of dwarven brewing to non-dwarven lands. Though this has given you skill in the brewer's craft, it's also earned you distrust among dwarven purists." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Profession› (brewer) and ‹skill/Craft› (alchemy) checks, but you take a -1 penalty on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks made to change the attitude of dwarves who know that your family has shared brewing secrets with non-dwarves."}

child_of_zolurket.name: Child of Zolurket
description: ::trait{title="&L&Child of Zolurket&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="You come from a family whose ancestors worked in the platinum mines near Tar Urkatka, now known as Zolurket. Your parents never explained why they've never returned to Zolurket, but they did make sure that you knew your way around a fight against undead foes." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus to weapon damage against undead."}

clearheaded.name: Clearheaded
description: ::trait{title="&L&Clearheaded&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="You see through deception and lies." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on opposed checks against the ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Disguise› skills and a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against illusion effects."}

deep_marker.name: Deep Marker
description: ::trait{title="&L&Deep Marker&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="You've dared uncharted tunnels in pursuit of the gladdringgar (the chiseling of name-runes in subterranean depths)." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Survival› checks, and a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against fear effects."}

fungal_brewing.name: Fungal Brewing
description: ::trait{title="&L&Fungal Brewing&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Craft› checks to create alchemical items, and can create nonmagical alchemical materials in 20% less time than normal."}

goldsniffer.name: Goldsniffer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Goldsniffer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="Your keen senses lead you to hidden treasures." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Perception› checks related to metals, jewels, and gemstones."}

grounded.name: Grounded
description: ::trait{title="&L&Grounded&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="You are well balanced, both physically and mentally." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on balance-related ‹skill/Acrobatics› checks, and a +1 trait bonus on Reflex saves."}

gunworker.name: Gunworker
description: ::trait{title="&L&Gunworker&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="You lived among the dwarven alchemists who work with firearm technology in Dongun Hold." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Craft› checks involving firearms, explosives, and alchemical weapons that deal fire damage."}

insular_dwarf.name: Insular (Dwarf)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Insular (Dwarf)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="You hail from one of the remote dwarven holds of the North, and have learned that the people of these harsh lands are as fickle as the weather. Experience has taught you that outsiders are not to be trusted." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Sense Motive› checks, and Sense Motive is always a class skill for you, but you take a -1 penalty on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks with non-dwarves."}

militant_merchant.name: Militant Merchant
description: ::trait{title="&L&Militant Merchant&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="You know what it takes to get your goods to market and will stop at nothing to protect your products. Years of fending off thieves, cutthroats, and brigands have given you a sixth sense when it comes to danger." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus to ‹skill/Perception› checks made to determine surprise, and Perception is always a class skill for you."}

ruthless.name: Ruthless
description: ::trait{title="&L&Ruthless&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="You never hesitate to strike a killing blow." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on attack rolls to confirm critical hits."}

sky_quester.name: Sky Quester
description: ::trait{title="&L&Sky Quester&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="You grew up hearing stories of the lost Sky Citadels, and have sworn to find and reclaim one." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (geography)› and ‹skill/Knowledge (history)› checks. One of these skills (your choice) is always a class skill for you."}

spellcasters_anathema.name: Spellcaster's Anathema
description: ::trait{title="&L&Spellcaster's Anathema&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="You see arcane magic as untrustworthy and its use as a calamity waiting to happen." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on attack rolls against arcane spellcasters."}

tunnel_fighter.name: Tunnel Fighter
description: ::trait{title="&L&Tunnel Fighter&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="Caves and tunnels are a second home to you." benefit="While underground, you receive a +2 trait bonus on initiative checks and a +1 trait bonus on weapon damage rolls for critical hits (this damage is multiplied on a critical hit)."}

warsmith.name: Warsmith
description: ::trait{title="&L&Warsmith&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="You have an intuitive grasp of the weak points of metal and stone." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus to damage rolls against creatures and objects made primarily of clay, crystal, earth, metal, or stone. ‹skill/Knowledge (engineering)› is a class skill for you."}

zest_for_battle.name: Zest for Battle
description: ::trait{title="&L&Zest for Battle&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›" flavor="Your greatest joy is being in the thick of battle, and smiting your enemies for a righteous or even dastardly cause." benefit="Whenever you have a morale bonus to weapon attack rolls, you also receive a +1 trait bonus on weapon damage rolls."}

deathkeeper.name: Deathkeeper
description: ::trait{title="&L&Deathkeeper&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›; Pahmet" flavor="You have lived for a time deep inside the necropolises of the pharaohs. Your exposure to undead creatures and their necromantic energies has strengthened your ability to resist the powers of the unliving." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against the supernatural abilities of undead creatures."}

sphinxfriend.name: Sphinxfriend
description: ::trait{title="&L&Sphinxfriend&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Dwarf›; Pahmet" flavor="You were raised near the lair of a proud ‹family/sphinx›. Well known for their wisdom, sphinxes are greatly respected by your people, and in times of uncertainty and crisis, their counsel has been invaluable. When you came of age, you were chosen to be the emissary between your settlement and the sphinx. Luckily for you, the proud creature enjoyed your company, and in addition to bartering for information, you learned to enjoy the riddles of your noble friend." benefit="As a result of your experiences, you gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks, ‹skill/Linguistics› skill checks made to decipher writing in an unfamiliar language, and ‹skill/Sense Motive› checks made to discern secret messages."}

arcane_dabbler.name: Arcane Dabbler
description: ::trait{title="&L&Arcane Dabbler&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›" flavor="Though your magical studies were decades ago, you still remember your favorite little trick." benefit="Choose a 0-level arcane spell. You may cast that spell once per day as a spell-like ability. Your caster level is equal to your highest class level in a spellcasting class; if you have no caster level, it functions at CL 1st. The spell-like ability's save DC is Intelligence- or Charisma-based (chosen when you select this trait)."}

dilettante_artist.name: Dilettante Artist
description: ::trait{title="&L&Dilettante Artist&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›" flavor="Art for you is a social gateway and you use it to influence and penetrate high society." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus to one category of ‹skill/Perform› checks and a +1 trait bonus to ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks. One of these skills (your choice) is always a class skill for you."}

forlorn.name: Forlorn
description: ::trait{title="&L&Forlorn&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›" flavor="Having lived outside of traditional elf society for much or all of your life, you know the world can be cruel, dangerous, and unforgiving of the weak." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on Fortitude saving throws."}

insular_elf.name: Insular (Elf)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Insular (Elf)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›" flavor="After living among non-elves for a time, you developed a dismissive attitude toward rash, shorter-lived races." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on Will saving throws against charm, compulsion, and fear effects created by humanoids other than elves."}

keeper_of_the_secret_shame.name: Keeper of the Secret Shame
description: ::trait{title="&L&Keeper of the Secret Shame&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›" flavor="You are a member of the ‹rule/Lantern Bearers› or an agent of the Winter Council, tasked with ensuring that knowledge of the elves' secret shame - the drow - never reaches the surface." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge› checks pertaining to drow and drow settlements."}

lapsed_faith.name: Lapsed Faith
description: ::trait{title="&L&Lapsed Faith&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›" flavor="You still remember a few prayers from your past experience serving in a temple." benefit="Once per day you may cast ‹spell/cure light wounds› as a spell-like ability at caster level 1. The save DC is Wisdom-based."}

planetary_traveler.name: Planetary Traveler
description: ::trait{title="&L&Planetary Traveler&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›" flavor="You take every opportunity to learn about or visit far-off planets." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (geography)›, ‹skill/Knowledge (local)›, and ‹skill/Knowledge (nature)› checks regarding other planets."}

seeker_of_brightness.name: Seeker of Brightness
description: ::trait{title="&L&Seeker of Brightness&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›" flavor="You have been actively searching for signs of the Brightness since childhood." benefit="Choose a ‹skill/Knowledge› skill; you gain a +1 trait bonus on Knowledge checks of that type and on ‹skill/Perception› checks."}

sovyrian_intellectual.name: Sovyrian Intellectual
description: ::trait{title="&L&Sovyrian Intellectual&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›; Must be a 1st-level character" flavor="Having grown up in one of the intellectual centers of Castrovel, you speak precisely and persuasively, especially among elves." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks. This bonus increases to +3 against creatures with the elf subtype."}

tropical_botanist.name: Tropical Botanist
description: ::trait{title="&L&Tropical Botanist&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›" flavor="You are familiar with beneficial and dangerous plants." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (nature)› checks to locate or identify plants and on saving throws against the extraordinary abilities of plants."}

warrior_of_old.name: Warrior of Old
description: ::trait{title="&L&Warrior of Old&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›" flavor="As a child, you put in long hours on combat drills, and though time has made this training a dim memory, you still have a knack for quickly responding to trouble." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on initiative checks."}

wild_stride.name: Wild Stride
description: ::trait{title="&L&Wild Stride&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›" benefit="Choose a favored terrain from those listed in the ranger ‹ability/favored terrain› class ability. You can move through naturally occurring difficult terrain without any penalty while within your favored terrain. Terrain created or modified by magic or traps affects you normally."}

youthful_mischief.name: Youthful Mischief
description: ::trait{title="&L&Youthful Mischief&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›" flavor="Though you gave up the life of a padfoot, scout, or minstrel decades before, you still know how to roll with the punches when things turn sour." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on Reflex saves."}

obscure_traditions.name: Obscure Traditions
description: ::trait{title="&L&Obscure Traditions&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›; Snowcaster" flavor="You confound those who think they know about elves." benefit="Any creature attempting to make a ‹skill/Knowledge› check about your people, a ‹skill/Sense Motive› check to determine whether you are lying, or a ‹skill/Survival› check to track you takes a -2 penalty on the check.~~~Additionally, any character or creature that normally gains a bonus on attack or damage rolls against elves (such as a ranger's ‹ability/favored enemy› ability) has such a bonus reduced by 1 (minimum 0)."}

snowblooded.name: Snowblooded
description: ::trait{title="&L&Snowblooded&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Elf›; Snowcaster" flavor="Your family has a long tradition of producing excellent sentries and ‹arc-skald/twilight speaker«s›." benefit="You gain a +4 trait bonus on Fortitude saving throws made to avoid nonlethal damage from cold environments, and gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against spells with the cold descriptor."}

adaptable_flatterer.name: Adaptable Flatterer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Adaptable Flatterer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Fetchling›" flavor="A life spent avoiding racial mistrust has taught you to humor others effectively when it is useful to do so." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› checks and on attack rolls against opponents who are denied their Dexterity bonus to AC against you."}

murky_allegiance.name: Murky Allegiance
description: ::trait{title="&L&Murky Allegiance&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Fetchling›" flavor="You came of age in a place where fetchlings serve dark forces." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› checks to send secret messages and to imply you serve a powerful sinister conspiracy, evil authority figure, or shadow government. You also gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks when interacting with such entities."}

shadow_stalker.name: Shadow Stalker
description: ::trait{title="&L&Shadow Stalker&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Fetchling›" flavor="You are dedicated to mastering the art of hiding in the shadows." benefit="Increase the miss chance gained from your *shadow blending* ability by 5%."}

weathered.name: Weathered
description: ::trait{title="&L&Weathered&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Fetchling›" benefit="Because of your natural resistances, you gain a +2 trait bonus on saves to resist cold or electricity effects and hazards."}

creative_reality.name: Creative Reality
description: ::trait{title="&L&Creative Reality&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Ganzi›" flavor="Straightforward answers bore you, for they only encourage people to depend on others rather than find out for themselves. You have grown adept over the years at convincing people of falsehoods and couching your honest answers in so much doublespeak they may as well be lies." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› checks, which increases to +5 when attempting to convince someone an honest answer is a falsehood."}

frustrating.name: Frustrating
description: ::trait{title="&L&Frustrating&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Gathlain›" flavor="You can get anyone's attention, even when they are focused elsewhere." benefit="You can make ‹skill/Bluff› checks to create a diversion for allies within 30 feet to hide (provided they readied an action to hide), and you can make Bluff checks to feint for one adjacent ally of your choice. Either use of this ability is a @HLstandard_action."}

genie_heir.name: Genie Heir
description: ::trait{title="&L&Genie Heir&FN&" type="Race" req="Geniekin" flavor="You once met one of your genie ancestors, who taught you the ways of her race and their allies." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on Charisma checks and Charisma-based skill checks to influence outsiders from the home plane of your genie ancestor."}

minor_wishcraft.name: Minor Wishcraft
description: ::trait{title="&L&Minor Wishcraft&FN&" type="Race" req="Geniekin" flavor="You gained some power of wishcraft from a genie ancestor." benefit="You can spend a use of a racial spell-like ability or your *elemental assault* racial trait for the day to instead use any 0-level spell as a spell-like ability. The spell must be used to produce an effect requested aloud by a humanoid within 30 feet since the end of your last turn."}

honored_provider.name: Honored Provider
description: ::trait{title="&L&Honored Provider&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Ghoran›" flavor="Nex depends upon the food produced by ghorans, and you inspire gratitude in creatures you feed." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff›, ‹skill/Diplomacy›, and ‹skill/Sense Motive› checks to interact with a person to whom you have given needed food in the past 24 hours."}

azlanti_inheritor.name: Azlanti Inheritor
description: ::trait{title="&L&Azlanti Inheritor&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Gillman›" flavor="You have prominent Azlanti features, which you can use to inspire confidence in your allies." benefit="Whenever you use the ‹rule/aid another<_2› action to aid an adjacent ally, increase the bonus you grant your ally by 1. This is a trait bonus."}

memory_mastery.name: Memory Mastery
description: ::trait{title="&L&Memory Mastery&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Gillman›" flavor="You can suppress your own memories to help tell more convincing lies." benefit="Once per day as an @HLimmediate_action, you can cause yourself to forget a single event or fact for a period of 10 minutes. Enemies reading your mind cannot learn the information. Until the memory returns, you gain a +10 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› checks to convince others that you do not know the information."}

adrenaline_rush.name: Adrenaline Rush
description: ::trait{title="&L&Adrenaline Rush&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Gnome›" flavor="You are determined to ward off the Bleaching, and get a certain thrill out of being forced to experience negative emotions." benefit="Once per day when you fail a saving throw against a spell with the emotion descriptor, you can gain 1d6 ‹rule/temporary hit points›. These temporary hit points last for 1 minute."}

animal_friend.name: Animal Friend
description: ::trait{title="&L&Animal Friend&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Gnome›" flavor="You've long been a friend to animals, and feel safer when animals are nearby." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on Will saving throws as long as an animal (Tiny or larger, must be at least indifferent toward you) is within 30 feet, and ‹skill/Handle Animal› is always a class skill for you."}

brastlewark_businessman_ceod.name: Brastlewark Businessman (CEoD)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Brastlewark Businessman (CEoD)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Gnome›" flavor="Your time among the Brastlewark elite has led to an extensive knowledge of alchemy and ready connections in the trade." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on all ‹skill/Craft› (alchemy) checks."}

efficient_packer.name: Efficient Packer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Efficient Packer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Gnome›" flavor="You were once delighted to discover an object that could be the crown jewel of your collection, only to be thwarted by its weight. Thereafter, you trained yourself to pack items in the most efficient ways possible." benefit="Treat your Strength score as 2 points higher when calculating your ‹rule/carrying capacity›."}

forest_senses.name: Forest Senses
description: ::trait{title="&L&Forest Senses&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Gnome›" benefit="When in any unsettled, uncivilized terrain, you gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Perception› checks to act during a surprise round, and take no penalty on Perception checks while sleeping."}

illusion_obsession.name: Illusion Obsession
description: ::trait{title="&L&Illusion Obsession&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Gnome›" flavor="After realizing the great potential of illusions - particularly figments - for use in pranks, you became obsessed with studying their properties and better methods to cast them." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus to your caster level when casting illusions of the figment subschool."}

industrious.name: Industrious
description: ::trait{title="&L&Industrious&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Gnome›" flavor="You are helpful and hardworking." benefit="When you successfully use the ‹rule/aid another› action to aid an ally's Craft or Profession check, that character gains an additional +1 trait bonus on the check (in addition to the +2 bonus normally granted for successfully aiding another). If you have a racial bonus on that skill, your ally gains a +2 trait bonus instead."}

prankster.name: Prankster
description: ::trait{title="&L&Prankster&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Gnome›" flavor="You always have a great idea for a prank." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹rule/dirty trick› combat maneuver checks. You also gain a +1 trait bonus to your CMD when an opponent attempts a dirty trick combat maneuver check against you. If you succeed at a dirty trick combat maneuver check against a ‹rule/flat-footed› opponent, increase the duration of the condition caused by 1 round."}

rapscallion.name: Rapscallion
description: ::trait{title="&L&Rapscallion&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Gnome›" flavor="You've spent your entire life thumbing your nose at the establishment and take pride in your run-ins with the law. Somehow, despite all your mischievous behavior, you've never been caught - you always manage to stay one step ahead of your pursuers." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Escape Artist› checks and a +1 trait bonus on initiative checks."}

snowstepper.name: Snowstepper
description: ::trait{title="&L&Snowstepper&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Gnome›" flavor="As a native of the North, you have acquired the ability to tread lightly on snow." benefit="You ignore difficult terrain caused by snow, and it costs you only 2 squares of movement to enter a square covered in ‹rule/heavy »snow›, rather than 4 squares of movement. This benefit only applies when you are not carrying a medium or heavier load."}

vermin_wrangler.name: Vermin Wrangler
description: ::trait{title="&L&Vermin Wrangler&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Gnome›" flavor="In gathering ingredients necessary for mind-altering drugs and other concoctions, you have become intimately familiar with the desert's many-legged pests." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (dungeoneering)› checks to identify vermin and on saving throws against vermin's extraordinary abilities."}

advantageous_distraction.name: Advantageous Distraction
description: ::trait{title="&L&Advantageous Distraction&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Goblin›" flavor="Like most goblins, you're easily distracted. Unlike most goblins, though, you have a knack for being distracted at the right time, especially when it comes to avoiding pain." benefit="Once per day as a @HLswift_action, you can be momentarily distracted in combat: ducking an axe swing to inspect a toadstool, or stooping behind a tree to lick some bark and accidentally avoiding an arrow, and so on. When you activate this ability, you gain a +2 dodge bonus to your AC for 1 round."}

balloon_headed.name: Balloon Headed
description: ::trait{title="&L&Balloon Headed&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Goblin›" flavor="Your head is particularly wide and large, even for a goblin." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Perception› checks, and Perception is always a class skill for you. Any ‹skill/Escape Artist› checks that requires you to squeeze your head through a tight space take a -8 penalty."}

big_ears.name: Big Ears
description: ::trait{title="&L&Big Ears&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Goblin›" benefit="Your massive ears are your pride and joy, and other goblins claim you can hear a flea scream as it falls off a goblin dog. While this might not quite be the case, you gain a +2 bonus on all ‹skill/Perception› checks made to hear noises. Additionally, you can hear noises that normally only dogs or other animals can hear, like the sound of a dog whistle."}

bouncy.name: Bouncy
description: ::trait{title="&L&Bouncy&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Goblin›" flavor="Your bones, flesh, and skin are a bit more elastic than those of most goblins - when you fall, you tend to bounce a little better as a result." benefit="Whenever you take ‹rule/falling« damage›, the first 1d6 points of lethal damage suffered in the fall are automatically converted to nonlethal damage. You also gain a +2 trait bonus on all Reflex saves made to avoid unexpected falls."}

bully_burner.name: Bully Burner
description: ::trait{title="&L&Bully Burner&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Goblin›" flavor="You were forced to serve cruel hobgoblins at some point, much to your abject humiliation and frustration, and memories of this inspire a rage that lends you strength." benefit="Against creatures with the goblinoid subtype, you gain a +1 trait bonus on combat maneuver checks and a +1 trait bonus to CMD."}

color_thief.name: Color Thief
description: ::trait{title="&L&Color Thief&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Goblin›" benefit="Your skin is an odd tint that somehow absorbs background colors. Maybe because your mother drank a lot of potions when you were still inside her belly. Maybe because you've been blessed by the ‹monster/barghest«s›. Maybe because you're just better than the other boring goblins. In any case, you gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Stealth› checks, providing you wear only light armor or no armor."}

dog_sniff_hate.name: Dog-Sniff-Hate
description: ::trait{title="&L&Dog-Sniff-Hate&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Goblin›" benefit="You gain the ‹umr/scent› special quality but only against canine creatures, like dogs or wolves, including monstrous hounds such as ‹monster/hell hound«s›, ‹monster/yeth hound«s›, and even ‹template/werewolves›. You gain a +2 trait bonus on attack rolls against dogs you can smell."}

foul_belch.name: Foul Belch
description: ::trait{title="&L&Foul Belch&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Goblin›" benefit="Once per day as a @HLstandard_action, you can force a particularly odious belch at a single opponent within 5 feet. The character affected must make a DC 12 Fortitude save or be ‹misc/sickened› for 1d6 rounds. The save DC is Constitution-based."}

goblin_bravery.name: Goblin Bravery
description: ::trait{title="&L&Goblin Bravery&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Goblin›" flavor="You have a worrying propensity for overconfidence in combat." benefit="When facing an enemy that's larger than you, if you have no allies in any adjacent squares, your posturing, bravado, and cussing grant a +1 trait bonus on attack rolls with non-reach melee weapons."}
:::aside
This trait was printed as "Goblin Foolhardiness" in *Goblins of Golarion.*

pustular.name: Pustular
description: ::trait{title="&L&Pustular&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Goblin›" flavor="Your face is covered with unpleasant pimples and outright boils that have a tendency to pop at inopportune moments. Although this makes you particularly ugly, you're also used to discomfort." benefit="Whenever you're subjected to an effect that causes the ‹misc/sickened› condition, you may make two saving throws to avoid the effect (if a saving throw is allowed), taking the better of the two results as your actual saving throw."}

rude_songs.name: Rude Songs
description: ::trait{title="&L&Rude Songs&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Goblin›" benefit="Providing an opponent can hear and understand you, the lyrics of your songs are so personally insulting that you gain a +2 trait bonus on all ‹skill/Perform› (sing) checks. Perform is always a class skill for you."}

ugly_swine.name: Ugly Swine
description: ::trait{title="&L&Ugly Swine&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Goblin›" flavor="You are a repulsive little freak whose origins are unclear. Your head is small for a goblin and your mouth oddly narrow, allowing you to pass in urban environments as an unidentifiable mongrel, providing you keep a low profile. However, if examined closely, your goblin origins are revealed." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Disguise› checks, and Disguise is a class skill for you."}

canopy_shooter.name: Canopy Shooter
description: ::trait{title="&L&Canopy Shooter&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Grippli›" flavor="Growing up in a dangerous jungle, you learned to take advantage of your mobility relative to larger predators and elusive prey." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ranged weapon damage rolls when you are on higher ground than your target and are within 30 feet."}

bifurcated_magic.name: Bifurcated Magic
description: ::trait{title="&L&Bifurcated Magic&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-elf›" flavor="You've studied the methods of both elven and human spellcasters." benefit="Pick two classes when you gain this trait - your caster level in each of those classes is treated as 1 higher as long as this doesn't raise your caster level above your total Hit Dice. This doesn't stack with any similar increase from traits such as ‹trait/Magical Knack›."}

elven_reflexes.name: Elven Reflexes
description: ::trait{title="&L&Elven Reflexes&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-elf›" flavor="One of your parents was a member of a wild elven tribe, and you've inherited a portion of your elven parent's quick reflexes." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on initiative checks."}
:::aside
This was printed in *Legacy of Fire Player's Guide* as "Ekujae Reflexes" and specifies that "one of your parents was a member of the Ekujae tribe of the Mwangi Expanse."

experimental_rebel.name: Experimental Rebel
description: ::trait{title="&L&Experimental Rebel&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-elf›" flavor="Your elven relatives were cold to you and you took to rebelling simply to get attention." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on saving throws against spells and abilities created by elves."}

failed_apprentice.name: Failed Apprentice
description: ::trait{title="&L&Failed Apprentice&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-elf›" flavor="As a child, your parents sent you to a distant wizard's tower as an apprentice so that you could learn the arcane arts. Unfortunately, you had no arcane talent whatsoever, though you did learn a great deal about the workings of spells and how to resist them." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on saves against arcane spells."}

pearl_diver_pots.name: Pearl Diver (PotS)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Pearl Diver (PotS)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-elf›" flavor="You are skilled at finding treasures in the warm coastal waters near the desert." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Perception› checks while underwater and can ‹misc/hold your breath› for a number of rounds equal to three times your Constitution score before you risk drowning."}

wild_domesticator.name: Wild Domesticator
description: ::trait{title="&L&Wild Domesticator&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-elf›" benefit="‹skill/Handle Animal› is always a class skill for you. You gain a +2 trait bonus on Handle Animal checks to train an animal, and can teach a trained animal one additional trick beyond its normal maximum."}

child_of_two_peoples.name: Child of Two Peoples
description: ::trait{title="&L&Child of Two Peoples&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-elf›, ‹race/Half-orc›, or ‹race/Human›" flavor="Your parents come from two visibly different cultures that maintain distinct identities regardless of their physical proximity (such as Tians and Ulfen). The tug of conflicting expectations has strengthened your sense of individuality and given you a gift for languages." benefit="You receive a +2 trait bonus on Will saves against charm and compulsion effects, and you automatically know the racial or ethnic ‹misc/languages› of both your parents."}

elven_serenity.name: Elven Serenity
description: ::trait{title="&L&Elven Serenity&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-elf›; elf-raised" flavor="You embody the peace of the elven way of life, and apply this philosophy in your interactions with others." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› and ‹skill/Handle Animal› checks to calm other creatures. You need not speak the same language to attempt a Diplomacy check in this manner."}

trade_talk.name: Trade Talk
description: ::trait{title="&L&Trade Talk&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-elf›; human-raised" flavor="You picked up not only the basics of your human parent's profession, but also the lingo typical of the craft." benefit="Choose a ‹skill/Craft› or ‹skill/Profession› skill. You gain a +1 trait bonus on checks with the chosen skill, and a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Sense Motive› checks when dealing with people in the context of that craft or profession."}

almost_human.name: Almost Human
description: ::trait{title="&L&Almost Human&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc›" flavor="You have enough human features that it's easy for you to pass for a pure-blooded human." benefit="You gain a +4 trait bonus on ‹skill/Disguise› checks to pass as human, and Disguise is always a class skill for you."}

brute_apg.name: Brute (APG)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Brute (APG)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc›" flavor="You have worked for a crime lord, either as a low-level enforcer or as a guard, and are adept at frightening away people." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Intimidate› checks, and Intimidate is always a class skill for you."}

caravan_drover.name: Caravan Drover
description: ::trait{title="&L&Caravan Drover&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc›" flavor="With your hand on the lash, your caravans always arrive on time." benefit="You treat ‹eq-weapon/whip«s› as martial weapons, and up to 10 animals and humanoids traveling with you can ‹rule/hustle› or make a forced march for 1 hour longer than normal before taking nonlethal damage and becoming fatigued."}

cruel_rager.name: Cruel Rager
description: ::trait{title="&L&Cruel Rager&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc›" benefit="If you successfully confirm a critical hit against an enemy while *raging,* you regain 1 round of *rage.* This can occur only once per *rage.*"}

irritable_diplomat.name: Irritable Diplomat
description: ::trait{title="&L&Irritable Diplomat&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc›" flavor="Most people expect half-orcs to be savage and violent, and you're used to working a little harder to overcome their assumptions. Unfortunately, you're still working on keeping patient when they ignore your efforts." benefit="Once per day, you may choose to gain a +5 trait bonus on any ‹skill/Diplomacy› check, but if it fails, you take a -2 penalty on all Charisma-based checks for the next 10 minutes."}

lasting_ferociousness.name: Lasting Ferociousness
description: ::trait{title="&L&Lasting Ferociousness&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc› with *orc ferocity*" benefit="Increase the number of rounds you can act as ‹misc/disabled› from your *orc ferocity* racial trait to 2 rounds."}

legacy_of_sand.name: Legacy of Sand
description: ::trait{title="&L&Legacy of Sand&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc›" flavor="A large tribe of orcs adapted to life in the desert once dwelt in southeastern Katapesh. Although this tribe is long extinct, some half-orcs of Katapesh carry the traits of this tribe in their particularly large jaws, broad shoulders, and shockingly pale eyes.~~~You often have dreams of hunts and strange ceremonies held under moonlight in the desert sands. Some ascribe these dreams to racial memory, others to visions or prophecies. These dreams have instilled in you a fierce sense of tradition." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on all Will saving throws."}

mistrusted.name: Mistrusted
description: ::trait{title="&L&Mistrusted&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc›" benefit="Choose humans or orcs. You learned during your earliest interactions with that race that some automatically consider you a threat because of your hybrid nature, and they can't be easily placated. Against foes of the chosen race, you gain a +1 trait bonus on attacks of opportunity and a +1 trait bonus to your CMD."}

outcast.name: Outcast
description: ::trait{title="&L&Outcast&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc›" flavor="Driven from town after town because of your heritage, you have become adept at living apart from others." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Survival› skill checks, and Survival is always a class skill for you."}

promising_peacemaker.name: Promising Peacemaker
description: ::trait{title="&L&Promising Peacemaker&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc›" flavor="You were raised by a mix of human and orc family members, or by accommodating half-orc parents, and many people expected you to act as a flawless peacemaker. Whether these hopes saw fruition or met with frustration, you learned a great deal about both cultures." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (local)› checks involving orcs, half-orcs, and humans, and a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks against members of those races."}

scrapper.name: Scrapper
description: ::trait{title="&L&Scrapper&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc›" flavor="A childhood spent scrabbling for every possession and scrap of food has made you fierce and wary." benefit="You receive a +1 trait bonus on all ‹skill/Intimidate› checks made to demoralize opponents and a +1 trait bonus on all ‹skill/Perception› checks to avoid being surprised."}

wild_ferocity.name: Wild Ferocity
description: ::trait{title="&L&Wild Ferocity&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc›" benefit="Select one terrain type from the ranger's ‹ability/favored terrain› list. While in this terrain type, taking a @HLstandard_action while ‹misc/disabled› does not cause you to take the normal 1 point of damage. You can use this trait when acting as if disabled despite having a negative hit point total as a result of *orc ferocity* or the ‹feat/Diehard› feat."}

amazingly_ugly.name: Amazingly Ugly
description: ::trait{title="&L&Amazingly Ugly&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc› or ‹race/Orc›" flavor="Your skull is misshapen in a grotesque way." benefit="You receive a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Intimidate› skill checks, and it becomes a class skill."}

beast_rider.name: Beast Rider
description: ::trait{title="&L&Beast Rider&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc› or ‹race/Orc›" flavor="You have a knack for breaking animals to your will, though you know little of civilized training methods." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Ride› checks, but should you ever be forcibly dismounted in combat, your mount attacks you to the best of its ability."}

big_mouth.name: Big Mouth
description: ::trait{title="&L&Big Mouth&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc› or ‹race/Orc›" flavor="You have an innate ability to weave stories about yourself that extol your might and prowess." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on all ‹skill/Bluff›, ‹skill/Intimidate›, and ‹skill/Perform› (oratory) checks made against orcs."}

brute_orc.name: Brute (Orc)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Brute (Orc)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc› or ‹race/Orc›" flavor="You are an especially large and hulking individual, and when you strike, you aim to deliver the maximum amount of pain." benefit="Whenever you score a critical threat, you add (but not multiply, in the case of a confirmed critical hit) an amount of damage equal to your weapon's critical modifier."}

deadeye.name: Deadeye
description: ::trait{title="&L&Deadeye&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc› or ‹race/Orc›" flavor="You have only one working eye, but that eye is especially keen." benefit="You receive a +2 trait bonus on all ‹skill/Perception› checks involving sight."}

demented_inventor.name: Demented Inventor
description: ::trait{title="&L&Demented Inventor&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc› or ‹race/Orc›" flavor="You adore crafting new and ever more creative weapons, and some of them even work." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Craft› (weapons) checks, and it becomes a class skill."}

dirty_fighter_orc.name: Dirty Fighter (Orc)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Dirty Fighter (Orc)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc› or ‹race/Orc›" flavor="You were raised to fight with every dirty trick in the book." benefit="You receive a +3 trait bonus on all attempts to ‹rule/feint› in combat using your ‹skill/Bluff› skill."}

mindlessly_cruel.name: Mindlessly Cruel
description: ::trait{title="&L&Mindlessly Cruel&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc› or ‹race/Orc›" flavor="You take delight in delivering vicious blows with cruel weapons." benefit="Whenever you have a morale bonus on weapon attack rolls, you also receive a +1 trait bonus on weapon damage rolls."}

rage_of_storms.name: Rage of Storms
description: ::trait{title="&L&Rage of Storms&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc› or ‹race/Orc›" flavor="Summoned creatures can inherit your ferocity." benefit="Once per day, a creature you summon creature can have the ‹umr/ferocity› ability."}

tribal.name: Tribal
description: ::trait{title="&L&Tribal&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc› or ‹race/Orc›" benefit="You are especially devoted to your tribe, and within 60 feet of a tribal standard, you gain a +1 trait bonus on attack rolls and Will saves against fear effects, as if you were the recipient of a ‹spell/bless› spell."}

tusked.name: Tusked
description: ::trait{title="&L&Tusked&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc› or ‹race/Orc›" benefit="Huge, sharp tusks bulge from your mouth, and you receive a ‹umr/bite attack› (1d4 damage for Medium characters). If used as part of a full attack action, the bite attack is made at your full base attack bonus -5."}

unbreakable_hate.name: Unbreakable Hate
description: ::trait{title="&L&Unbreakable Hate&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc› or ‹race/Orc›" flavor="Your ferocity is focused into your spells, and it is harder to break your concentration." benefit="You receive a +2 trait bonus on all ‹rule/concentration› checks."}

iron_control.name: Iron Control
description: ::trait{title="&L&Iron Control&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc›; human-raised" flavor="You learned the hard way that expressing the rage you inherited from your orc blood exacerbates humans' fearful and hostile reactions to you; after years of effort, you've mastered self-control and buried your anger deep." benefit="Whenever you're ‹misc/confused› and roll to determine behavior in a given round, subtract 10 from the result."}

finish_the_fight.name: Finish the Fight
description: ::trait{title="&L&Finish the Fight&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Half-orc›; orc-raised" flavor="You're at the bottom of the pecking order, so when you challenge that order, your victory must be absolute." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on attack rolls against opponents you already injured in the past 24 hours."}

bellflower_contact.name: Bellflower Contact
description: ::trait{title="&L&Bellflower Contact&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Halfling›" flavor="Before you were old enough to be a ‹rule/Bellflower Network› member, you kept an ear out for information useful to slave liberators." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Perception› checks, ‹skill/Sense Motive› checks to understand secret messages, and ‹skill/Bluff› checks to send secret messages."}

freed_slave_fg.name: Freed Slave (FG)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Freed Slave (FG)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Halfling›; Member of The ‹rule/Bellflower Network›" flavor="You grew up as a slave in Cheliax and know the ins and outs of Chelish nobility better than most." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› and ‹skill/Knowledge (nobility)› checks and Knowledge (nobility) is a class skill for you."}

freedom_fighter_halfling.name: Freedom Fighter (Halfling)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Freedom Fighter (Halfling)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Halfling›" flavor="Your parents allowed escaping slaves to hide in your home, and the stories you've heard from them instilled into you a deep loathing of slavery." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on any skill check or attack roll made during the process of escaping capture or in helping a slave escape bondage, and ‹skill/Escape Artist› is always a class skill for you."}

helpful_halfling.name: Helpful (Halfling)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Helpful (Halfling)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Halfling›" flavor="You see nothing wrong with letting others achieve greatness so long as the job gets done." benefit="Whenever you successfully perform an ‹rule/aid another› action, you grant your ally a +4 bonus instead of the normal +2."}

intrepid_volunteer.name: Intrepid Volunteer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Intrepid Volunteer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Halfling›" flavor="Like many free halflings, you volunteered readily for military service or an adventuring career and met other halflings who showed you how to make up for your small size." benefit="Choose one Strength-based skill or one combat maneuver. You can use your Dexterity modifier in place of your Strength modifier to calculate your total modifier for that skill check or combat maneuver check."}

lettered.name: Lettered
description: ::trait{title="&L&Lettered&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Halfling›" flavor="You can read a smattering of most languages and know enough to make pretty good guesses about the rest." benefit="‹skill/Linguistics› is a class skill for you, and you gain a +1 trait bonus on Linguistics checks made for the purpose of deciphering writing in an unfamiliar language. You never draw a false conclusion if you fail your Linguistics check; instead, you simply realize you cannot make sense of the writing."}

perfect_servant.name: Perfect Servant
description: ::trait{title="&L&Perfect Servant&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Halfling›" flavor="Your training as a maid or valet has left you with unconscious mannerisms that seem to put members of the upper class at ease." benefit="You gain a +3 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks made to influence anyone with at least one level of ‹npcclass/Aristocrat›."}

providential_passenger.name: Providential Passenger
description: ::trait{title="&L&Providential Passenger&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Halfling›" flavor="Those who travel for a living understand that your mere presence could make the difference between success and failure once a journey begins, and this gives you an edge when negotiating your fare or other privileges." benefit="Improve the starting ‹skill/attitude› that ship captains, caravan leaders, and those with similar sorts of responsibilities have toward you by one step."}

scrounger.name: Scrounger
description: ::trait{title="&L&Scrounger&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Halfling›" flavor="Others may call it junk, but you call it a bargain." benefit="You can buy objects with the ‹misc/broken› condition at half price (instead of the normal three-quarters price). The value of the unbroken version of these objects cannot exceed four times your character level. The price you pay for this object can never exceed more than twice your character level in gp (for example, at 5th level you can spend up to 10 gp on a broken object, meaning you can buy any object that, if not broken, has a value of 20 gp or less)."}

slave_smuggler.name: Slave Smuggler
description: ::trait{title="&L&Slave Smuggler&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Halfling›" flavor="You know how to get contraband across borders." benefit="When hiding a Medium or smaller creature from an opponent actively searching you or your cargo, both you and the creature to be smuggled can attempt ‹skill/Stealth› checks and select the higher of the two results for your smuggled ally to use while hiding."}

successful_shirker.name: Successful Shirker
description: ::trait{title="&L&Successful Shirker&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Halfling›" flavor="Born and raised a slave with no hope of advancement, you are adept at avoiding your overseer's ire and attention, the better to spend time on your own interests." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Stealth› checks and a +3 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks to avoid punishment by lawful authority."}

well_informed.name: Well-Informed
description: ::trait{title="&L&Well-Informed&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Halfling›" benefit="You make it a point to know everyone and to be connected to everything around you. You frequent the best taverns, attend all of the right events, and graciously help anyone who needs it. Because of this, you gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks to gather information and ‹skill/Knowledge (local)› checks. One of these skills (your choice) is always a class skill for you."}

wild_shadow.name: Wild Shadow
description: ::trait{title="&L&Wild Shadow&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Halfling›" benefit="Select one terrain type from the ranger's ‹ability/favored terrain› list. You can attempt ‹skill/Stealth› checks in this terrain in normal light without having cover or being invisible. You still can't attempt Stealth checks in areas of bright light without invisibility or cover."}

adventurous_explorer.name: Adventurous Explorer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Adventurous Explorer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Halfling›; Song-o" flavor="You are one of the few Song-o halflings to brave the world outside the Laughing Jungle." benefit="When ‹misc/frightened› or ‹misc/shaken›, you only take a -1 penalty on your rolls instead of -2."}

inciter_hobgoblin.name: Inciter (Hobgoblin)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Inciter (Hobgoblin)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Hobgoblin›" flavor="You witnessed or were part of a feud that turned close friends into hateful enemies." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› checks to convince others that their allies have wronged them and on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks to persuade others to betray their allies' trust."}

friend_to_animals.name: Friend to Animals
description: ::trait{title="&L&Friend to Animals&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›" flavor="You grew up in close proximity to animals and relate with them intuitively." benefit="You gain a +1 bonus on ‹skill/Handle Animal› and ‹skill/Ride› checks, and one of those skills (your choice) is always a class skill for you."}

plague_survivor.name: Plague Survivor
description: ::trait{title="&L&Plague Survivor&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›" flavor="You survived an encounter with disease in a slum or contagion-prone area." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on Fortitude saving throws against diseases and on Constitution checks to stabilize while ‹misc/dying›."}

scholar_of_ruins.name: Scholar of Ruins
description: ::trait{title="&L&Scholar of Ruins&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›" flavor="From the moment you could walk and talk, the ruins of ancient civilizations have fascinated you. Because of this, you have special insight into geography as well as expertise in exploring lost places." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (geography)› and ‹skill/Knowledge (dungeoneering)› checks. One of these skills (your choice) is always a class skill for you."}

survivalist.name: Survivalist
description: ::trait{title="&L&Survivalist&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›" benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against natural environmental hazards."}

trifler.name: Trifler
description: ::trait{title="&L&Trifler&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Varisian wanderers" flavor="A childhood spent at your mystically gifted grandmother's side has taught you the basics of real magic." benefit="You may cast ‹spell/prestidigitation› three times per day as a spell-like ability. This spell-like ability is cast at your highest caster level; if you have no caster level, it functions at CL 1st."}

world_traveler.name: World Traveler
description: ::trait{title="&L&World Traveler&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›" flavor="Your family has taken the love of travel to an extreme, roaming the world extensively. You've seen dozens of cultures and have learned to appreciate the diversity of what the world has to offer." benefit="Select one of the following skills: ‹skill/Diplomacy›, ‹skill/Knowledge (local)›, or ‹skill/Sense Motive›. You gain a +1 trait bonus on checks with that skill, and it is always a class skill for you."}

azlant_fanatic.name: Azlant Fanatic
description: ::trait{title="&L&Azlant Fanatic&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Azlanti" flavor="Your years spent in libraries reading every musty tome you could find about the ancient lost civilization of Azlant have given you insight into the subjects of history and the arcane." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus to ‹skill/Knowledge (arcana)› and ‹skill/Knowledge (history)› checks. One of these skills (your choice) is always a class skill for you."}

azlanti_engineering.name: Azlanti Engineering
description: ::trait{title="&L&Azlanti Engineering&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Azlanti" flavor="You were trained in the style of Azlanti architecture and craft." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (engineering)› checks. In addition, any masterwork item you craft has its hardness and break DC increased by 1. This increase is an enhancement bonus."}

enduring_spellcraft.name: Enduring Spellcraft
description: ::trait{title="&L&Enduring Spellcraft&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Azlanti" flavor="You have studied the enduring spells of ancient Azlant." benefit="Treat your caster level as 1 higher for the purpose of determining duration only."}

nomadic.name: Nomadic
description: ::trait{title="&L&Nomadic&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Bas-o" flavor="You have lived among the Bas-o and know Sargava well." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (geography)› and ‹skill/Survival› checks, and one of these skills (your choice) is always a class skill for you."}

bekyar_slave_maestro.name: Bekyar Slave Maestro
description: ::trait{title="&L&Bekyar Slave Maestro&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Bekyar or Shoanti" flavor="You spent years using your magic to bend the will of captured slaves to suit your whims." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› and ‹skill/Intimidate› checks against anyone you have held captive for at least 24 hours."}

shoanti_spirit_singer.name: Shoanti Spirit-singer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Shoanti Spirit-singer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Bekyar or Shoanti" flavor="The spirit voices of your ancestors sing to you of the world around you." benefit="Once per day, you can act in the surprise round even if you aren't aware of your attackers; you can use this action only to start a ‹ability/bardic «song<performance› or ‹ability/raging song›, and you're still considered ‹rule/flat-footed› until you act in the first normal round of combat."}

glib_barrister.name: Glib Barrister
description: ::trait{title="&L&Glib Barrister&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Chelaxian" flavor="You grew up within a bureaucratic system where law reigns supreme; however, that has never stopped you from creating loopholes in ironclad contracts." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Linguistics› checks to create forgeries."}

infernal_influence.name: Infernal Influence
description: ::trait{title="&L&Infernal Influence&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Chelaxian" flavor="Your family boasts secret diabolical ties that may go back much further than the Thrune regime, and much deeper." benefit="You gain fire ‹umr/resistance› 1 and a +1 trait bonus on Fortitude saves against poison."}

ingratiating.name: Ingratiating
