description: ::trait{title="&L&Ingratiating&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Chelaxian" flavor="Someone close to you was removed from her position and replaced after losing the government's favor, and you had to quickly prove your loyalty to her replacement or face your own disgrace." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks when interacting with people in positions of authority over you."}

masterful_demeanor.name: Masterful Demeanor
description: ::trait{title="&L&Masterful Demeanor&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Chelaxian" flavor="As a proud Chelaxian, you are confident that members of other, inferior races will obey you, and quickly." benefit="You gain a +3 trait bonus on ‹skill/Intimidate› checks against members of non-human humanoid races."}

obsessed_with_success.name: Obsessed with Success
description: ::trait{title="&L&Obsessed with Success&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Chelaxian" flavor="A Chelaxian without a visible degree of success is marked as pathetic, and so you grew up careful not to let failure stick." benefit="Once per day, when you re-attempt a skill check you have previously failed within the last minute, you can add a +4 trait bonus to that check."}

operatic.name: Operatic
description: ::trait{title="&L&Operatic&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Chelaxian" flavor="You grew up in wonder of Chelish theater, and spent countless hours in the opera houses across Cheliax and even more time perfecting your voice." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Perform› (sing) checks. Furthermore you have memorized the librettos of many works sung in the ancient Azlanti tongue, granting you a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Linguistics› checks when trying to decipher the ancient Azlanti language."}

colonial_entitlement.name: Colonial Entitlement
description: ::trait{title="&L&Colonial Entitlement&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Chelaxian or Sargavan" flavor="You are a firm believer in the superiority of your Chelish heritage, and you cling to your racial and cultural pride." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Intimidate› checks against Mwangi."}

spirit_lodge_dreamer.name: Spirit Lodge Dreamer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Spirit Lodge Dreamer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Erutaki" flavor="You have experienced visions of the unseen spirit world, and bear the marks of the spirits upon your flesh." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on saves against illusions, and reduce any miss chance you would take from ‹rule/concealment› by 10%."}

effortless_aid.name: Effortless Aid
description: ::trait{title="&L&Effortless Aid&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Garundi" flavor="You naturally observe others, and move to complement them." benefit="Once per day as a @HLmove_action, you can select an adjacent ally. For the next minute, you can take 10 on attack rolls and skill checks to use the ‹rule/aid another<_2› action to aid that ally, even if you are distracted."}

ever_home.name: Ever Home
description: ::trait{title="&L&Ever Home&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Garundi" flavor="You have lived in many cities dotting the northern coastline of Garundi, and after you have departed from each, you have taken a small token to remember it by." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (geography)› and ‹skill/Sleight of Hand› checks."}

eyes_of_the_sun.name: Eyes of the Sun
description: ::trait{title="&L&Eyes of the Sun&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Garundi" flavor="You are inured to the bright glare of the hot desert sun, and its dazzling rays pose little danger to you." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against effects that would cause you to become ‹misc/dazzled› or ‹misc/blinded›, and once per day when you would be dazzled or blinded by an effect, you can reduce the duration of that effect by half (minimum 1 round). You cannot use this ability if you are already dazzled or blinded or if you have the ‹umr/light sensitivity› or ‹umr/light blindness› special quality."}

historian.name: Historian
description: ::trait{title="&L&Historian&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Garundi" flavor="Your parents were scholars of history, whether genealogists of your own family tree, sages on the subject of ancient empires, or simply hobbyists with a deep and abiding love for the past." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (history)› checks and *bardic knowledge* checks, and Knowledge (history) is always a class skill for you."}

relic_hunter.name: Relic Hunter
description: ::trait{title="&L&Relic Hunter&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Garundi" flavor="You have made a study of the ancient lands and ruins of Garund and are familiar with the relics and artifacts their inhabitants left behind." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Appraise› and ‹skill/Knowledge (history)› checks made to examine ruined buildings more than 1,000 years old as well as any ruined objects found in them. If such an item is magical, you gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Spellcraft› checks to identify its properties and ‹skill/Use Magic Device› checks to activate it."}

tongue_of_many_towns.name: Tongue of Many Towns
description: ::trait{title="&L&Tongue of Many Towns&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Garundi" flavor="You have spent many years traveling across Garund, and have met many different people on your journeys." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on two of the following skills: ‹skill/Diplomacy›, ‹skill/Knowledge (local)›, and ‹skill/Linguistics›."}

zealous_garundi.name: Zealous (Garundi)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Zealous (Garundi)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Garundi" flavor="You felt lost and aimless in your youth until a patron's emotional intervention showed you the power of throwing yourself completely into what you do." benefit="Once per day, you can add a +2 trait bonus on any attack roll, saving throw, or skill check. You must choose to apply this bonus before rolling the die. When you use this ability, you take a -2 penalty to your AC and on saving throws until the end of your next turn."}

born_to_the_water.name: Born to the Water
description: ::trait{title="&L&Born to the Water&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Ijo" flavor="You were born on the shore, and you easily live on and under the water." benefit="You gain a +1 bonus on ‹skill/Swim› checks and only need to make Swim checks once every 2 hours to avoid fatigue, instead of once each hour."}

jadwiga_scion.name: Jadwiga Scion
description: ::trait{title="&L&Jadwiga Scion&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Jadwiga" flavor="You come from a family that commands respect." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Intimidate› checks, and Intimidate is always a class skill for you. In addition, you gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (nobility)› checks related to the Irrisen aristocracy."}

carefully_hidden.name: Carefully Hidden
description: ::trait{title="&L&Carefully Hidden&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Keleshite" flavor="Modern Taldor is not kind to Keleshites. Your life as a member of an unpopular ethnic group has given you an uncanny knack for avoiding detection." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus to Will saves and a +2 trait bonus to saving throws versus divination effects."}

commanding.name: Commanding
description: ::trait{title="&L&Commanding&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Keleshite" flavor="Your family taught you that you always deserve respect." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Intimidate› checks. Add a +1 trait bonus to the save DC of any language-dependent compulsion spells you cast."}

genie_blood.name: Genie Blood
description: ::trait{title="&L&Genie Blood&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Keleshite" flavor="One of your ancestors was genie-kind." benefit="Select an element (air, earth, fire, or water). You gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against attacks that utilize that element (cold for air, acid for earth, fire for fire, and electricity for water),&dagger& and gain a +1 trait bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sense Motive checks made against creatures of that subtype.~~~>&dagger& This is different from the usual associations, where cold is water and electricity is air. Consult your GM if you want to use the normal associations."}

horse_lord.name: Horse Lord
description: ::trait{title="&L&Horse Lord&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Keleshite" flavor="You grew up racing along the plains of Paresh, hoping to one day compete in the Histaqen." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Handle Animal› checks, and a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Ride› checks. This trait applies only to horses."}

market_rat.name: Market Rat
description: ::trait{title="&L&Market Rat&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Keleshite" flavor="You spent your youth amid the varied market stalls and mercantile leagues across Golarion. Perhaps you came from a family of merchants, or you dwelt amid the many booths of a market, begging to survive." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Appraise› and ‹skill/Knowledge (local)› checks."}

pride_of_the_diamond_empire.name: Pride of the Diamond Empire
description: ::trait{title="&L&Pride of the Diamond Empire&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Keleshite" flavor="Your pride is so strong and your confidence so sure that you can shake off magical attempts to shatter your resolve." benefit="If you succeed at a Will saving throw against a fear effect that would result in a lesser effect on a successful save (such as causing you to become ‹misc/shaken› instead of ‹misc/panicked›), you are instead unaffected."}

tempestuous_combatant.name: Tempestuous Combatant
description: ::trait{title="&L&Tempestuous Combatant&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Keleshite" flavor="You move confidently in the face of danger." benefit="Once per day as a @HLswift_action, you can choose one opponent. You and your mount (if any) do not provoke attacks of opportunity from that opponent for moving within or exiting his threatened area."}

thoroughbred.name: Thoroughbred
description: ::trait{title="&L&Thoroughbred&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Keleshite" flavor="The blood of the early horse tribes is strong in your family. Breeding, riding, selecting, and training the best horses are all part of your legacy, and you know how to pick out the best of the lot when selecting a suitable mount." benefit="If you gain a ‹companion/horse› as an animal companion or mount as one of your class abilities, its base speed increases by 5 feet and it gains a bonus trick that does not count against the normal limit of tricks known by the animal."}

divine_the_mystery.name: Divine the Mystery
description: ::trait{title="&L&Divine the Mystery&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Kellid" flavor="Your time spent exploring the ruins of Silver Mount has taught you much about the strange ways of the metal creatures from the stars." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (engineering)› checks to identify creatures with the robot subtype and relics of Numerian technology. When using ‹skill/Bluff› to feint against an intelligent construct, you do not take a penalty for feinting against a non-humanoid."}

ice_walker.name: Ice Walker
description: ::trait{title="&L&Ice Walker&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Kellid" flavor="You spent years roaming the frozen tundra of the frigid north, and have adapted to its numbing effects." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against attacks that deal cold damage. Furthermore, you may ignore the ‹skill/Acrobatics› penalty for ice and can move across ice at normal speed."}

pragmatic_polytheist.name: Pragmatic Polytheist
description: ::trait{title="&L&Pragmatic Polytheist&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Kellid" flavor="You pray to whatever local deity will answer your prayers - and if they won't, to hell with them." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (religion)› checks and can make Knowledge (religion) checks as if trained. Once per day, you can cast ‹spell/resistance› on yourself as a spell-like ability cast at your highest caster level (CL 1st if you have no caster level)."}

storied_scars.name: Storied Scars
description: ::trait{title="&L&Storied Scars&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Kellid" flavor="You proudly bear the numerous scars of your life on your body, and each one tells a tale of your experiences." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks made to interact with other Kellids, and a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Intimidate› checks when dealing with non-Kellid peoples."}

superstitious_kellid.name: Superstitious (Kellid)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Superstitious (Kellid)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Kellid" flavor="You have a healthy fear of sorcerers' speech and wizards' words that has helped you to survive their charms." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against arcane spells."}

wary_of_danger.name: Wary of Danger
description: ::trait{title="&L&Wary of Danger&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Kellid" flavor="Your people are beset on all sides by threats, and you have developed a keen sense for danger." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on initiative checks."}

wasteland_hunter.name: Wasteland Hunter
description: ::trait{title="&L&Wasteland Hunter&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Kellid" flavor="You are an expert hunter among your tribe." benefit="Whenever you throw a ‹eq-weapon/club›, ‹eq-weapon/shortspear›, ‹eq-weapon/spear›, or ‹eq-weapon/javelin›, reduce the penalty for throwing the weapon beyond its initial range increment by 2 (to a minimum penalty of 0). For example, a club (with a range of 10 feet) thrown at a target 25 feet away would incur only a -2 penalty with this trait."}

weathered_patience.name: Weathered Patience
description: ::trait{title="&L&Weathered Patience&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Kellid" flavor="You had to learn to control your attention to survive in the wilds." benefit="Once per day, when you ‹rule/ready› an action to make a ranged or melee weapon attack, you can add a +4 trait bonus on the attack."}

witness_to_natures_cruelty.name: Witness to Nature's Cruelty
description: ::trait{title="&L&Witness to Nature's Cruelty&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Kellid" flavor="You saw firsthand the terrible toll of starvation and the elements, and refuse to allow even your worst enemy to suffer that way." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Heal› and ‹skill/Survival› checks made on behalf of others. One of these skills (your choice) is always a class skill for you."}

assimilated_native.name: Assimilated Native
description: ::trait{title="&L&Assimilated Native&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Mwangi" flavor="You have adopted the ways of the colonials. As a result, you feel that other, &quot&inferior&quot& races - such as your Mwangi brethren - should obey you as they do the colonials." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Intimidate› checks to influence Mwangi natives, but you suffer a -2 on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks to influence them."}

colonial_sympathizer.name: Colonial Sympathizer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Colonial Sympathizer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Mwangi" flavor="Your behavior is heavily influenced by the Sargavan colonials." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks involving Sargavan colonials and others with this trait."}

magaambyan_arcana.name: Magaambyan Arcana
description: ::trait{title="&L&Magaambyan Arcana&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Mwangi" benefit="Your study of Magaambyan magic traditions allows you to add one spell with the good descriptor from the ‹main/spells_>druid› or ‹main/spells_>cleric› spell list to the spell list of an arcane spellcasting class of your choice, at the same spell level as it appears on the cleric or druid list. Pick the spell when you choose this trait."}

proud_tribesman.name: Proud Tribesman
description: ::trait{title="&L&Proud Tribesman&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Mwangi" flavor="You may have to coexist with the colonials, but you don't have to like them." benefit="You gain a +2 bonus on checks to ‹skill/Intimidate› colonial Sargavans."}

river_trader.name: River Trader
description: ::trait{title="&L&River Trader&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Mwangi" flavor="You have learned to ply the rivers and the markets with equal ease." benefit="You gain a +1 bonus on ‹skill/Appraise› and ‹skill/Swim› checks, and one of these skills (your choice) is always a class skill for you."}

spirits_in_the_stone.name: Spirits in the Stone
description: ::trait{title="&L&Spirits in the Stone&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Mwangi" flavor="You have an almost instinctive ability to sense danger and peril in ruined structures." benefit="Whenever you're in ruins, you gain a +2 trait bonus on Initiative checks and a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against traps and natural hazards."}

student_of_nantambu.name: Student of Nantambu
description: ::trait{title="&L&Student of Nantambu&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Mwangi" flavor="You have spent time at ‹rule/Magaambya›, the magical academy of Nantambu, absorbing the ancient knowledge taught there." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (arcana)› and ‹skill/Spellcraft› checks, and you may make these checks untrained."}

trailblazer.name: Trailblazer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Trailblazer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Mwangi" flavor="Your ability to endure in the darkest jungles has earned you a reputation as a novice guide." benefit="While traversing any wilderness, you gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Survival› checks, and gain a +1 trait bonus on Fortitude saving throws against diseases."}

slaver.name: Slaver
description: ::trait{title="&L&Slaver&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Ombo" flavor="You may never have participated in a single slave raid, but members of other tribes recognize you as Ombo, and they fear and distrust you accordingly." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Intimidate› checks to influence non-Ombo Mwangi, but you suffer a -2 penalty on ‹skill/Bluff› or ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks to influence them."}

auspicious_tattoo.name: Auspicious Tattoo
description: ::trait{title="&L&Auspicious Tattoo&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Shoanti" flavor="You bear a tattoo depicting one of the totems listed for your quah that favors you with good fortune." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on Will saving throws."}

bred_for_war.name: Bred for War
description: ::trait{title="&L&Bred for War&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Shoanti" flavor="You tower above most other humans and possess a physique of hard, corded muscle." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Intimidate› checks and a +1 trait bonus on your CMB because of your great size. You must be at least 6 feet tall."}

favored_champion.name: Favored Champion
description: ::trait{title="&L&Favored Champion&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Shoanti" flavor="Omens from the spirits indicated you would be a great champion against your tribe's enemies." benefit="Once per day as an @HLimmediate_action when you fail a combat maneuver check, you can reroll it. You must take the second result even if it is worse."}

oral_historian.name: Oral Historian
description: ::trait{title="&L&Oral Historian&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Shoanti" flavor="You learned numerous mnemonic devices to more easily recall information imparted by your quah's master storyteller." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (history)› and ‹skill/Perform› (oratory) checks, and one of those skills (your choice) is always a class skill for you."}

shoanti_steed.name: Shoanti Steed
description: ::trait{title="&L&Shoanti Steed&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Shoanti" benefit="Your nomadic culture gives you a profound knowledge of and respect for the horses that roam your homelands.`You begin play with a combat trained ‹eq-misc/light horse›. While riding this horse bareback, you are treated as though you were riding it with a ‹eq-misc/riding saddle› (placing any actual saddle upon the horse negates this benefit). The horse can fend for itself outside of settlements in all but the most hostile environments. If whistled for outside of a community, the horse typically arrives within 1d6 minutes.~~~If your horse is slain, you may receive a new horse by returning to your clan and performing a vigil for its spirit (a rite that costs 100 gp in rare herbs and incense)."}

shoanti_tattoo.name: Shoanti Tattoo
description: ::trait{title="&L&Shoanti Tattoo&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Shoanti" flavor="Upon reaching adulthood, you received a tribal tattoo, marking you with the symbols of your quah and totem spirits." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against fear effects. Additionally, you are proficient with ‹eq-weapon/earth breaker«s›, ‹eq-armor/klar«s›, and ‹eq-weapon/Shoanti bolas›."}

artistic_dilettante.name: Artistic Dilettante
description: ::trait{title="&L&Artistic Dilettante&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Taldan" flavor="You come from money, and because of this can quickly discern objects' value." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Appraise› checks, and on checks for one ‹skill/Craft› skill of your choice."}

aspiring_bard.name: Aspiring Bard
description: ::trait{title="&L&Aspiring Bard&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Taldan" flavor="You spent countless hours of your youth wandering the open campuses of the ‹rule/Kitharodian Academy› and the Rhapsodic College, listening to wonderful musicians and singers and daydreaming of your life as a bard." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus to one category of ‹skill/Perform› checks and a +2 trait bonus to any ‹skill/Knowledge (local)› checks that deal with the Oppara music scene."}

blade_bravado.name: Blade Bravado
description: ::trait{title="&L&Blade Bravado&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Taldan" flavor="You grew up fighting in one of the many Taldan dueling academies and have honed your skills with one-handed weapons." benefit="When wielding a one-handed weapon and nothing in your off hand, you gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Acrobatics› and ‹skill/Bluff› checks."}

destined_pioneer.name: Destined Pioneer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Destined Pioneer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Taldan" flavor="Your forebears served in an Army of Exploration, and you retain that expansionist spirit." benefit="Select a terrain from the ‹class/ranger«'s› list of ‹ability/favored terrain«s›. Once selected, this choice cannot be changed. Once per day while in the selected terrain, you may move across nonmagical ‹rule/difficult terrain› as though it were not difficult terrain until the end of your turn."}

generous.name: Generous
description: ::trait{title="&L&Generous&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Taldan" flavor="Your neighbors gained your respect with their generosity, and you emulate their example." benefit="Whenever you give to a creature a gift or service worth at least 25 gold pieces &times& the creature's CR, you gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks against that creature for the next 24 hours."}

my_word_is_my_bond.name: My Word Is My Bond
description: ::trait{title="&L&My Word Is My Bond&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Taldan" flavor="Your reliability is a core part of your self-image." benefit="Once per day, you can gain a +1 trait bonus on an attack roll, saving throw, or skill check if success on that check is directly relevant to fulfilling a verbal or written agreement you have made. You must choose to use this trait before rolling, and this ability does not work if you initiated the agreement for the purpose of activating this ability."}

bureaucracy_navigator.name: Bureaucracy Navigator
description: ::trait{title="&L&Bureaucracy Navigator&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Tian" benefit="Accustomed to wading through governmental bureaucracy, you gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks against bureaucrats and on ‹skill/Knowledge (local)› checks related to laws and their enforcers."}

keeper_of_the_ancestral_scrolls.name: Keeper of the Ancestral Scrolls
description: ::trait{title="&L&Keeper of the Ancestral Scrolls&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Tian" flavor="You take pride in recording the genealogy of your family, tracing your heritage on large scrolls dating back hundreds, if not thousands of years." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (history)›, and ‹skill/Knowledge (nobility)› checks, and one of these skills (your choice) is always a class skill for you."}

master_of_the_sudden_strike.name: Master of the Sudden Strike
description: ::trait{title="&L&Master of the Sudden Strike&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Tian" flavor="You have mastered the deadly fighting arts of your people, and when you wield a ‹rule/masterwork<_w› version of any sword, you become one with its blade." benefit="If you act before your opponent during the surprise round, you gain a +2 trait bonus on weapon damage rolls for the surprise round only. This additional damage is precision damage."}

nearly_blinded.name: Nearly Blinded
description: ::trait{title="&L&Nearly Blinded&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Tian" flavor="After a close call with ‹rule/snow blindness› on the Crown of the World or the scouring winds of Hongal, you honed your instincts to protect your eyes." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on saving throws to avoid being ‹misc/blinded› or ‹misc/dazzled›."}

animalistic_affliction.name: Animalistic Affliction
description: ::trait{title="&L&Animalistic Affliction&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Ulfen" flavor="You grew up with an affinity for predatory animals, and whispers amid your clan suggest somewhere in the past, lycanthropy afflicted an ancestor. Whether or not you share this affliction, you often have animalistic urges." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Handle Animal› and ‹ability/Wild Empathy› checks."}

glint_tongued.name: Glint-Tongued
description: ::trait{title="&L&Glint-Tongued&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Ulfen" flavor="You have a gift for poetic turns of phrase and vicious streams of insults." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on Charisma-based skill checks made to impress or persuade other Ulfen (or, at the GM's option, other poetically-minded people), and a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Intimidate› checks."}

gruff_watcher.name: Gruff Watcher
description: ::trait{title="&L&Gruff Watcher&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Ulfen" flavor="Having grown up among headstrong sailors and bloodthirsty raiders, you learned to keep quiet and pay attention." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on initiative checks and ‹skill/Perception› checks."}

honor_driven.name: Honor-Driven
description: ::trait{title="&L&Honor-Driven&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Ulfen" flavor="Your honor is such a part of you that you can sense it (or its lack) in others." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Sense Motive› checks, and Sense Motive is always a class skill for you."}

shield_bearer.name: Shield Bearer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Shield Bearer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Ulfen" flavor="You have survived many battles thanks to your skill with your shield." benefit="When performing a ‹misc/shield bash›, you deal 1 additional point of damage. Also, once per day on your turn as a @HLfree_action, you may provide one adjacent ally a +2 trait bonus to his AC. This bonus lasts for 1 round, so long as you and the target remain adjacent to one another. You can only use this ability if you are using a shield. You retain your shield bonus to your armor class when using this ability."}

weapon_training.name: Weapon Training
description: ::trait{title="&L&Weapon Training&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Ulfen" flavor="As soon as you were old enough to hold it, you were trained to defend yourself with traditional Ulfen weapons." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on damage rolls with the following weapons: ‹eq-weapon/bastard sword›, ‹eq-weapon/battleaxe›, ‹eq-weapon/greataxe›, ‹eq-weapon/greatsword›, ‹eq-weapon/handaxe›, ‹eq-weapon/light hammer›, ‹eq-weapon/longbow›, ‹eq-weapon/longsword›, ‹eq-weapon/shortbow›, ‹eq-weapon/short sword›, ‹eq-weapon/throwing axe›, and ‹eq-weapon/warhammer›."}

harrow_born.name: Harrow Born
description: ::trait{title="&L&Harrow Born&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Varisian" flavor="You grew up around the mysterious fortune-tellers known throughout Ustalav and Varisia." benefit="You start play with a ‹eq-misc/harrow deck› passed down from a relative. Because of your skill with fortune-telling, you gain a +1 trait bonus on initiative checks."}

harrow_chosen.name: Harrow Chosen
description: ::trait{title="&L&Harrow Chosen&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Varisian" flavor="All your life you've been drawn to the mysteries surrounding your family's harrow deck." benefit="You begin play with your family's heirloom ‹eq-misc/harrow deck›. If you use this specific harrow deck as an additional focus component when you cast a divination spell, your caster level is treated as being 2 levels higher. Additionally, twice per week, you can spend 10 minutes consulting this harrow deck on a particular action to gain the effects of the spell ‹spell/augury› as a spellcaster of your character level. No one other than you gains these benefits from this harrow deck.~~~If your harrow deck is destroyed, it cannot be replaced. However, by returning to your family, paying 300 gp on materials, and spending 1 week immersed in the songs and stories of your people, you can create a new harrow deck that grants half the benefits of the lost heirloom."}

practiced_gambler.name: Practiced Gambler
description: ::trait{title="&L&Practiced Gambler&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Varisian" flavor="Your upbringing around the Sczarni has exposed you to games with cards and dice." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Sleight of Hand› checks; for the purpose of gambling, these bonuses increase by 1."}

stargazer_human.name: Stargazer (Human)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Stargazer (Human)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Varisian" flavor="You spent many years wandering the roads of Varisia and beyond, and during clear nights, you took to tracking the celestial bodies that adorn Golarion's skies." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (geography)› and ‹skill/Survival› checks."}

tattooed_focus.name: Tattooed Focus
description: ::trait{title="&L&Tattooed Focus&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Varisian" flavor="You possess an intricate tattoo that proclaims your skill at your chosen vocation." benefit="Choose a ‹skill/Craft›, ‹skill/Perform›, or ‹skill/Profession› skill. You gain a +2 trait bonus on checks with that skill, and it is always a class skill for you."}

varisian_tattoo.name: Varisian Tattoo
description: ::trait{title="&L&Varisian Tattoo&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Varisian" flavor="You bear the elaborate tattoos of your people, marking you as a free son or daughter of the road." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against charm and compulsion effects. Additionally, you are proficient with ‹eq-weapon/bladed scarves› and ‹eq-weapon/starknives›."}

varki_landspeaker.name: Varki Landspeaker
description: ::trait{title="&L&Varki Landspeaker&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Varki" flavor="You are deeply attuned to the lands your people call home and the spirits that live there." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Survival› checks in arctic or cold terrain. In addition, while in such terrain, you may query the spirits of the land once per day to gain a +5 trait bonus on a single skill check to follow tracks, forage, or find shelter."}

disciplined_body.name: Disciplined Body
description: ::trait{title="&L&Disciplined Body&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Vudrani" flavor="You respect your mind's mastery over your body's full potential." benefit="Once per day, you can use your Wisdom modifier instead of either your Strength or Dexterity modifier on an attack roll, a combat maneuver check, a Strength or Dexterity-based skill check, a Strength check, a Dexterity check, or a Reflex save. You must choose to use this trait before rolling."}

latent_psion.name: Latent Psion
description: ::trait{title="&L&Latent Psion&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Vudrani" flavor="The power to affect the world with the mind is very much a reality in your distant homeland. Although you may not even have been born in Vudra, this power remains potent in your mind as well and protects you from mental assault." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on saves against mind-affecting effects."}

open_palm_of_irori.name: Open Palm of Irori
description: ::trait{title="&L&Open Palm of Irori&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Vudrani" flavor="Your practice of the tenets of Vudrani martial arts has granted you a perfect balance between body and spirit." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Acrobatics› and ‹skill/Knowledge (religion)› checks. If you have a *ki pool,* once per day as a @HLswift_action, you may channel your *ki* during an unarmed strike, gaining a +2 trait bonus on one damage roll. This additional damage is ‹misc/precision damage›."}

sharp_wits.name: Sharp Wits
description: ::trait{title="&L&Sharp Wits&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Vudrani" flavor="You were raised with a daily regimen to keep your mind sharp and your words fluid." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹rule/concentration› checks and on ‹skill/Bluff› checks."}

voice_of_velvet.name: Voice of Velvet
description: ::trait{title="&L&Voice of Velvet&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Human›; Vudrani" flavor="You have the ability to sing a song and spin a story that captures the hearts of those around you." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› and ‹skill/Perform› (oratory) checks."}

expert_distractor.name: Expert Distractor
description: ::trait{title="&L&Expert Distractor&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Ifrit›" benefit="Whenever you damage an opponent that is casting a spell with a melee attack that deals fire damage (such as a ‹magic-enh/flaming› weapon or a ‹eq-misc/torch›), the DC of the ‹rule/concentration› check for your opponent to cast the spell is equal to 10 + the non-fire damage dealt + double the fire damage dealt + the spell's level (instead of just 10 + the damage dealt + the spell's level)."}

fiery_glare.name: Fiery Glare
description: ::trait{title="&L&Fiery Glare&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Ifrit›" flavor="You can use your unearthly nature to frighten others." benefit="You can always take 10 on ‹skill/Intimidate› checks, even in combat."}

hot_headed.name: Hot Headed
description: ::trait{title="&L&Hot Headed&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Ifrit›" flavor="The constant threat of slavers in your youth taught you to attack first and ask questions later." benefit="Whenever you ‹rule/charge›, you gain a +1 trait bonus on your damage roll."}

snap_ignition.name: Snap Ignition
description: ::trait{title="&L&Snap Ignition&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Ifrit›" flavor="You are a pyromaniac by nature and love nothing more than setting fires." benefit="As a @HLfull-round_action, you can produce a small flame at the end of your finger that ignites combustible materials as a ‹eq-misc/tindertwig›. Alternatively, you can maintain a flame equivalent to a ‹eq-misc/candle› by spending a @HLstandard_action each round to concentrate on it."}

unflappable_arrogance.name: Unflappable Arrogance
description: ::trait{title="&L&Unflappable Arrogance&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Ifrit›" flavor="You laugh in the face of your aggressors." benefit="The DC to demoralize you with the ‹skill/Intimidate› skill increases by 5. If an opponent's Intimidate check would be high enough to cause you to become demoralized for more than 1 round, you are instead demoralized for only 1 round."}

adroit.name: Adroit
description: ::trait{title="&L&Adroit&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kasatha›" benefit="If one of your hands is free and your base attack bonus is +1 or higher, you can draw a weapon as a @HLfree_action combined with any @HLmove_action (including move actions to direct spells, manipulate items, stand up, and so on)."}

covered_sniper.name: Covered Sniper
description: ::trait{title="&L&Covered Sniper&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kasatha›" flavor="You were attacked by strangers that threatened to expose your existence to dangerous forces and you defended yourself using cover." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ranged weapon damage rolls as long as you have ‹rule/cover› from your opponent."}

spidery_climber.name: Spidery Climber
description: ::trait{title="&L&Spidery Climber&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kasatha›" flavor="More hands means more handholds." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Climb› checks. In addition, as long as you have two hands free, the DC to catch yourself on a wall while falling is equal to the wall's DC + 10, and the DC to catch yourself on a slope is equal to the slope's DC + 5."}

among_humans.name: Among Humans
description: ::trait{title="&L&Among Humans&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kitsune›" flavor="You have spent your entire life living among humans and are an expert at impersonating them." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Disguise› checks to appear human while assuming your specific human form with the *change shape* racial trait, and Disguise is always a class skill for you."}

kami_respect.name: Kami Respect
description: ::trait{title="&L&Kami Respect&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kitsune›" flavor="Close contact with kami has given you an intuition for how to stay on their good side." benefit="‹family/Kami› automatically have a starting ‹skill/attitude› one step friendlier toward you, to a maximum of Friendly."}

nine_tailed_scion.name: Nine-Tailed Scion
description: ::trait{title="&L&Nine-Tailed Scion&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kitsune›" flavor="You are talented with kitsune magic." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on caster level checks for your racial spell-like abilities as well as those from the ‹feat/Magical Tail› feat. Additionally, you can select Magical Tail as a bonus feat whenever your favored class grants you a bonus bloodline feat, combat feat, or metamagic feat instead of the normal type of feat granted by that class.~~~You cannot exchange specific feats granted by a class or race for Magical Tail in this manner; for instance, a monk cannot exchange his ‹feat/Stunning Fist› feat for Magical Tail."}

carnation_scales.name: Carnation Scales
description: ::trait{title="&L&Carnation Scales&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›" flavor="Though your light pink scales made you the subject of ridicule by your tribe, you can adapt to more environments than they can." benefit="You gain a +1 bonus on ‹skill/Survival› checks, and Survival is always a class skill for you. Most kobolds with carnation scales also have the *day raider* alternate racial trait."}

golden_scales.name: Golden Scales
description: ::trait{title="&L&Golden Scales&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›" flavor="Your distinctive golden scales strongly reflect the light, making other kobolds mistrust you, but aboveground races favor you." benefit="You take a -1 penalty on ‹skill/Bluff› checks and ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks when dealing with other kobolds, but a +2 bonus on Bluff checks and Diplomacy checks when dealing with non-reptilian humanoids."}

kobold_faith.name: Kobold Faith
description: ::trait{title="&L&Kobold Faith&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›" flavor="You are one of the diehard kobold faithful, respected in your kobold community." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks when dealing with other kobolds. Additionally, if your deity grants the ‹domain/Artifice›, ‹domain/Earth›, or ‹domain/Trickery› domain, then your kobold faith unlocks a corresponding subdomain: Trap, Radiation, or Ambush."}

purple_scales.name: Purple Scales
description: ::trait{title="&L&Purple Scales&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›" flavor="Your outlandish purple scales made you an outcast from your tribe and forced you to survive in isolation at the edges of kobold society. While wandering alone through the Darklands, you contacted several other underground races and expanded your linguistic repertoire." benefit="In addition to speaking Draconic, you begin play with the ability to speak one of the following: Aklo, Dwarven, Goblin, or Undercommon."}

tribal_guide.name: Tribal Guide
description: ::trait{title="&L&Tribal Guide&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›" flavor="You were trained to guide the movements of larger creatures, perhaps travelers from Ilizmagorti or transports under Absalom." benefit="You provide food and water or a bonus against severe weather for two additional creatures whenever you succeed at the appropriate ‹skill/Survival› check, and Survival is a class skill for you."}

vexed.name: Vexed
description: ::trait{title="&L&Vexed&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›" flavor="You had multiple narrow escapes from gremlin saboteurs and learned to avoid their magic." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against curses and fear effects."}

bog_scamp.name: Bog Scamp
description: ::trait{title="&L&Bog Scamp&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; Black-scaled" flavor="You were raised in the sludgy swamps, and are used to moving through boggy terrain." benefit="You can swim through a ‹rule/deep bog› at up to half your speed as a move action, instead of the normal quarter speed. Failing a ‹skill/swim› check while in a deep bog doesn't cause you to go underwater, even if you fail by 5 or more, though such a failure still results in a lack of progress."}

ooze_defense.name: Ooze Defense
description: ::trait{title="&L&Ooze Defense&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; Black-scaled" flavor="The murky tunnels of your tribal home were infested with voracious oozes, which were a constant threat to your tribe. To protect yourselves, you and your tribespeople never strayed far without anti-ooze acid." benefit="You begin play with three ‹eq-weapon/alkali flask«s›. These don't count against your starting character wealth."}

sneaky_swimmer.name: Sneaky Swimmer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Sneaky Swimmer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; Black-scaled" flavor="Swimming comes naturally to you, as does hunting marsh vipers and other aquatic creatures." benefit="Increase the number of rounds you can ‹misc/hold your breath› underwater by an amount equal to your Constitution score. You gain a +2 bonus on ‹skill/Stealth› checks in swamps and in underwater environments."}

draconic_echo.name: Draconic Echo
description: ::trait{title="&L&Draconic Echo&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; Blue-scaled" flavor="Like the blue dragons your tribe reveres, you have a touch of illusory magic." benefit="You are able to cast ‹spell/ghost sound› twice per day as a spell-like ability. The caster level for this effect is equal to your character level. This spell-like ability's save DC is Intelligence-based."}

elaborate_trapper.name: Elaborate Trapper
description: ::trait{title="&L&Elaborate Trapper&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; Blue-scaled" flavor="You're blessed with a devious mind, and the more elaborate your traps are, the more effective they become." benefit="When creating a trap, if your ‹skill/Craft› (trap) roll exceeds the DC of the check by 5 or more, that trap's Disable Device DC increases by 2."}

lightning_blessed.name: Lightning Blessed
description: ::trait{title="&L&Lightning Blessed&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; Blue-scaled" flavor="You're favored by the lightning shaman of your tribe, and he gifted you several sacred items as a reminder of your origins." benefit="You begin play with three vials of ‹eq-weapon/bottled lightning›. These don't count against your starting character wealth."}

liquid_tongued.name: Liquid-Tongued
description: ::trait{title="&L&Liquid-Tongued&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; Blue-scaled" flavor="The magic-users in your tribe pride themselves on their ability to control the forces of water. Integral to this practice is the ability to study and communicate with visitors from the Elemental Plane of Water." benefit="In addition to speaking Draconic, you begin play with the ability to speak Aquan."}

alchemical_breath.name: Alchemical Breath
description: ::trait{title="&L&Alchemical Breath&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; Green-scaled" flavor="Your tribe, in an effort to emulate the green chromatic dragons they admire, goes to great lengths to secure alchemical coal." benefit="As a member of a green kobold tribe, you begin play with three pieces of the ‹eq-weapon/choking smoke› variety of alchemical coal. Eating one of these pellets allows you to exhale noxious vapors, damaging and sickening your enemies. These pellets do not count against your starting character wealth."}

kobold_herbalist.name: Kobold Herbalist
description: ::trait{title="&L&Kobold Herbalist&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; Green-scaled" flavor="You are familiar with the flora of your native forest and have rudimentary skill as an herbalist." benefit="Once per day, you can attempt a DC 20 ‹skill/Survival› check instead of a ‹skill/Craft› (alchemy) check to create a single dose of ‹eq-misc/scent cloak› without paying any cost for raw materials. Any scent cloak created using this method must be used within 24 hours, or it becomes inert."}

slithering_stride.name: Slithering Stride
description: ::trait{title="&L&Slithering Stride&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; Green-scaled" flavor="You were raised as a forest trapper, and are adept at moving quickly through underbrush." benefit="For 3 rounds per day, you can move through ‹rule/light or »heavy undergrowth› at full speed. This ability doesn't work in terrain that has been magically manipulated to impede motion."}

fire_tongued.name: Fire-Tongued
description: ::trait{title="&L&Fire-Tongued&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; Red-scaled" flavor="The sorcerers of your tribe are adept at summoning and binding outsiders from the Elemental Plane of Fire. In order to communicate with their thralls, many in your tribe learned the rudiments of the outsiders' language." benefit="In addition to speaking Draconic, you begin play with the ability to speak Ignan."}

firebug_kobold.name: Firebug (Kobold)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Firebug (Kobold)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; Red-scaled" flavor="Like the red dragons that inspire your tribe, you're blessed with a small spark of incendiary magic." benefit="You are able to cast ‹spell/spark› three times per day as a spell-like ability. The caster level is equal to your character level. This spell-like ability's save DC is Intelligence-based."}

heat_fortitude.name: Heat Fortitude
description: ::trait{title="&L&Heat Fortitude&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; Red-scaled" flavor="You grew up close to sulfurous volcanic vents, which steeled you against heat dangers." benefit="You gain a +4 trait bonus on Fortitude saving throws against nonlethal damage from heat."}

smoke_resistant.name: Smoke Resistant
description: ::trait{title="&L&Smoke Resistant&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; Red-scaled" flavor="You've spent so much of your life around fires that smoke no longer affects you the way it does other creatures." benefit="Your vision isn't impaired by nonmagical smoke, and you gain a +5 trait bonus on Fortitude saves to avoid coughing and choking because of ‹rule/smoke inhalation»<forest_fires›. This trait confers no benefits against magically created smoke, such as that produced by ‹spell/pyrotechnics›."}

cold_fortitude.name: Cold Fortitude
description: ::trait{title="&L&Cold Fortitude&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; White-scaled" flavor="The perpetually chilly environment of your youth made you exceptionally resilient in arctic climes." benefit="You gain a +4 trait bonus on Fortitude saving throws against nonlethal cold damage."}

frost_spitter.name: Frost Spitter
description: ::trait{title="&L&Frost Spitter&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; White-scaled" flavor="The icy breath of a white dragon fills your lungs." benefit="Once per day, you can quickly exhale to produce a frigid cloud of dense fog that quickly sinks to the ground. This freezing mist covers a 10-foot-square area with slippery ice that's as difficult to traverse as an ‹rule/cold>«ice sheet›."}

icy_mementos.name: Icy Mementos
description: ::trait{title="&L&Icy Mementos&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; White-scaled" flavor="As a parting gift, the shaman of your tribe gave you an alchemical concoction as a reminder of your icy home." benefit="You begin play with three bottles of ‹eq-weapon/liquid ice›. These don't count against your starting character wealth."}

skaters_balance.name: Skater's Balance
description: ::trait{title="&L&Skater's Balance&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Kobold›; White-scaled" flavor="You grew up stalking across the frozen pools of water that dot your tribe's Darklands home." benefit="You don't need to spend extra movement to enter a square of an ‹rule/cold>«ice sheet›, and the DCs of your ‹skill/Acrobatics› checks on ice sheets don't increase by 5."}

castrovel_gatekeeper.name: Castrovel Gatekeeper
description: ::trait{title="&L&Castrovel Gatekeeper&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Lashunta›" flavor="You helped maintain the interplanetary portals used for trade with other worlds." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Spellcraft› checks to identify teleportation magic and a +1 trait bonus on caster level checks when casting teleportation spells. You know the proper commands to operate a particular interplanetary portal (it is up to the GM as to where it is and how it operates)."}

skilled_telepath.name: Skilled Telepath
description: ::trait{title="&L&Skilled Telepath&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Lashunta›" benefit="The range of your *limited telepathy* racial ability increases by 5 feet."}

tactile_telekinesis.name: Tactile Telekinesis
description: ::trait{title="&L&Tactile Telekinesis&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Lashunta›" benefit="Once per day as a @HLswift_action, you can add a trait bonus equal to your Intelligence modifier on Strength checks and Strength-based skill checks you attempt before the beginning of your next turn."}

guarded.name: Guarded
description: ::trait{title="&L&Guarded&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Merfolk›" flavor="You grew up believing air-breathers are not to be trusted." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Sense Motive› checks against non-aquatic humanoids."}

longlung.name: Longlung
description: ::trait{title="&L&Longlung&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Monkey goblin›" flavor="You have spent long hours scouring shipwrecks and shoreline tide pools during low tide for shiny treasure." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Perception› checks while underwater and can ‹misc/hold your breath› for a number of rounds equal to three times your Constitution score before you risk drowning."}

nagaji_nationalist.name: Nagaji Nationalist
description: ::trait{title="&L&Nagaji Nationalist&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Nagaji›" flavor="Your loyalty to the nagaji nation of Nagajor is powerful." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on attack rolls and saving throws against foes that directly threaten the safety of Nagajor."}

animal_rustler.name: Animal Rustler
description: ::trait{title="&L&Animal Rustler&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Orc›" flavor="You frequently helped capture and wrangle dangerous animals and megafauna for your tribe, and you had to control them well enough to avoid being killed." benefit="Once per day, you can add your Strength modifier in addition to your Charisma modifier when attempting a ‹skill/Handle Animal› check."}

brimstone_seer.name: Brimstone Seer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Brimstone Seer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Orc›" benefit="You were exposed to vision-granting caustic vapors by the oracles of the Brimstone Haruspex, whether because you had a pressing question or because a parent or chieftain considered you an expendable proxy. The vapors left scars that impose a -1 penalty on Charisma-based checks, but once per day you gain a flash of insight that allows you to roll twice on a ‹skill/Knowledge› skill check or Intelligence check and take the better result. You must choose to use this trait before rolling."}

earthsense.name: Earthsense
description: ::trait{title="&L&Earthsense&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Oread›" flavor="You were inexplicably transformed in the womb by elemental forces, making your connection to the earth exceptionally strong." benefit="As a @HLswift_action, you can gain ‹umr/tremorsense› to a range of 60 feet until the beginning of your next turn. You can use this ability once per day at 1st level, plus one additional time per day at 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, to a maximum of five times per day at 20th level."}

loner_of_the_rocks.name: Loner of the Rocks
description: ::trait{title="&L&Loner of the Rocks&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Oread›" flavor="Feeling harried by flighty non-oreads, you chose to embrace the life of a hermit with few contacts beyond your rocky home." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Heal› and ‹skill/Survival› checks. Your bonus on Survival checks increases by 1 in underground or mountain environments."}

sandy_ambush.name: Sandy Ambush
description: ::trait{title="&L&Sandy Ambush&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Oread›" flavor="You are skilled at blending in with the desert terrain and attacking creatures as they pass by." benefit="When ‹rule/prone› in desert terrain, you gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Stealth› checks and take only a -2 penalty on attack rolls (rather than -4) when attacking from prone."}

statuesque.name: Statuesque
description: ::trait{title="&L&Statuesque&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Oread›" flavor="You inherited the statuesque physical features of your shaitan parent." benefit="‹skill/Disguise› becomes a class skill for you, and you gain a +2 trait bonus on Disguise checks to disguise yourself as a statue made of a specific type of stone, such as marble, sandstone, or alabaster. Furthermore, you take none of the penalties normally associated with disguising yourself as a different type of creature.~~~You must choose the type of stone you resemble when you take this trait; once chosen, it cannot be changed."}

stoic_dignity.name: Stoic Dignity
description: ::trait{title="&L&Stoic Dignity&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Oread›" flavor="You are an unmoving rock for those who see you as an authority figure." benefit="As long as you are conscious, you and all allies within 10 feet gain a +1 bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects you are not already suffering from. This is a trait bonus for you and a morale bonus for your allies."}

bauble_fascination.name: Bauble Fascination
description: ::trait{title="&L&Bauble Fascination&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Ratfolk›" flavor="You are fond of eldritch baubles and are skilled at activating their wondrous powers." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Use Magic Device› checks, and Use Magic Device is always a class skill for you."}

business_venturer.name: Business Venturer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Business Venturer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Ratfolk›" flavor="Your mercantile pursuits have sent you across Golarion, making you better traveled than most ratfolk." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Appraise›, ‹skill/Knowledge (local)›, and ‹skill/Profession› (merchant) checks, and one of these skills (your choice) is a class skill for you."}

ratfolk_avenger.name: Ratfolk Avenger
description: ::trait{title="&L&Ratfolk Avenger&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Ratfolk›" flavor="You protect your own." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on weapon damage rolls against opponents you have witnessed dealing damage to one of your allies."}

scamper.name: Scamper
description: ::trait{title="&L&Scamper&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Ratfolk›" flavor="In desperate times, your adrenaline kicks in to help you avoid danger." benefit="During the first round of combat in which you can act, you ignore ‹rule/difficult terrain› and gain an additional 5 feet of movement. This benefit does not apply when you are carrying a medium or heavier load."}

walls_of_half_truths.name: Walls of Half-Truths
description: ::trait{title="&L&Walls of Half-Truths&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Samsaran›" flavor="As soon as you made contact with other samsarans, they encouraged your talent for magic that befuddles foes." benefit="Treat your caster level as 1 higher for the purpose of determining duration of your figment and glamer spells."}

curse_in_the_blood.name: Curse in the Blood
description: ::trait{title="&L&Curse in the Blood&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›" flavor="You gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against curses." benefit="You treat your caster level as 1 higher when casting spells and spell-like abilities with the curse descriptor."}

marked_by_natures_magic.name: Marked by Nature's Magic
description: ::trait{title="&L&Marked by Nature's Magic&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›" flavor="You hail from a community - perhaps in Arcadia or the Lands of the Linnorm Kings - that encouraged you to interact with fey." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Knowledge (nature)› checks involving fey and on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks to influence fey. Knowledge (nature) is always a class skill for you."}

mastery_of_form.name: Mastery of Form
description: ::trait{title="&L&Mastery of Form&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›" flavor="You've never had trouble changing shape between beast and humanoid, and your ability to control your form is unparalleled." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on saving throws against polymorph effects."}

traumatic_shift.name: Traumatic Shift
description: ::trait{title="&L&Traumatic Shift&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›" flavor="Your first transformation was in a public place, observed by loved ones who later shunned you or townsfolk who chased you away. You have become good at hiding your nature." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› checks, and Bluff becomes a class skill for you."}

fight_with_the_flock.name: Fight with the Flock
description: ::trait{title="&L&Fight with the Flock&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Werebat-kin" flavor="You have always been most comfortable in a group. Since awakening to your werebat powers, this feeling has only grown." benefit="As long as you are within 10 feet of at least two allies, you gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Intimidate› checks and attack rolls to make attack of opportunity."}

precision_hearing.name: Precision Hearing
description: ::trait{title="&L&Precision Hearing&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Werebat-kin" flavor="You have long relied on your enhanced hearing to warn you of those who would persecute you for your nature." benefit="Whenever you succeed at a ‹skill/Perception› check to hear a creature you can't see and your check exceeds the DC by 10 or more, you can pinpoint the exact square where the sound originated."}

durable_change.name: Durable Change
description: ::trait{title="&L&Durable Change&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Werebear-kin" benefit="When you use your *change shape* ability, you can choose to gain the benefits of the ‹feat/Endurance› feat rather than gaining a special ability."}

reviving_rest.name: Reviving Rest
description: ::trait{title="&L&Reviving Rest&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Werebear-kin" flavor="When you first demonstrated your werebear ancestry, you slept for a week and awoke feeling more refreshed than ever before." benefit="Whenever you undergo complete ‹rule/bed rest› for 24 hours, you recover an amount of hit points equal to three times your character level."}

boar_resilience.name: Boar Resilience
description: ::trait{title="&L&Boar Resilience&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Wereboar-kin" flavor="You were victimized by bullies or even abusive adults. Although the harassment got worse when your wereboar features became more obvious, those features also gave you fortitude that helped you resist it." benefit="You are unimpaired by being at exactly 0 hit points. In addition, you can ignore the ‹feat/Endurance› prerequisite for the ‹feat/Diehard› feat."}

strength_of_body.name: Strength of Body
description: ::trait{title="&L&Strength of Body&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Wereboar-kin" flavor="You took longer than most to learn control over your transforming abilities, but in that time you learned a trick to make the most of your strength." benefit="Once per day, you can use your Strength modifier in place of your Constitution modifier on a single Fortitude saving throw. You must announce that you are using this ability before you roll the saving throw."}

crocodile_swim.name: Crocodile Swim
description: ::trait{title="&L&Crocodile Swim&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Werecrocodile-kin" flavor="You grew up near crocodiles, learning to move as they do." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Swim› and ‹skill/Stealth› checks while moving at half speed or less and mostly or completely underwater. One of these skills (your choice) becomes a class skill for you."}

terrifying_lunge.name: Terrifying Lunge
description: ::trait{title="&L&Terrifying Lunge&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Werecrocodile-kin" flavor="Once badly bitten by a stronger werecrocodile-kin, you learned the importance of showing your strength." benefit="Once per day, when you hit a ‹rule/flat-footed› foe with a melee attack, you can make an ‹skill/Intimidate› check to demoralize that foe as a @HLswift_action. Intimidate becomes a class skill for you."}

inured_to_disease.name: Inured to Disease
description: ::trait{title="&L&Inured to Disease&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Wererat-kin" flavor="The first sign of your wererat heritage was your seeming imperviousness to disease." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on Fortitude saving throws against diseases."}

rat_squeeze.name: Rat Squeeze
description: ::trait{title="&L&Rat Squeeze&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Wererat-kin" flavor="You first discovered your wererat-related abilities while escaping someone, whether the authorities or a rival, and ever since you have honed your ability to squeeze out of tight situations." benefit="Whenever you use your skinwalker ability to change shape into your bestial form, you can ‹misc/squeeze› through narrow spaces at least half as wide as your normal space without slowing your movement; each move into or through a narrow space counts as 1 square, though you still take all the normal penalties associated with squeezing."}

sharkchild.name: Sharkchild
description: ::trait{title="&L&Sharkchild&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Wereshark-kin" flavor="In your youth, you swam into the ocean as deep as you could, and had it not been for your wereshark ancestry you would have surely drowned." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Swim› checks. As long as you have a swim speed (such as that granted by your bestial form), you can use the run action to move up to five times your swim speed while swimming straight down from or straight up toward the surface of the water."}

shoreline_skirmisher.name: Shoreline Skirmisher
description: ::trait{title="&L&Shoreline Skirmisher&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Wereshark-kin" flavor="You were raised without many toys or possessions, but you made do exploring every detail of the nearby seashore, and know how to spot potential tools or obstacles." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on combat maneuver checks as long as you or your opponent is on sand or in water at least 6 inches deep."}

feline_instinct.name: Feline Instinct
description: ::trait{title="&L&Feline Instinct&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Weretiger-kin" flavor="When your weretiger heritage first manifested, you spent a period of time living off what you could catch, developing a sharp instinct to act when your foes were most vulnerable." benefit="In any combat in which you act during the surprise round, you gain a +3 trait bonus on your initiative check."}

tigers_claw.name: Tiger's Claw
description: ::trait{title="&L&Tiger's Claw&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Weretiger-kin" flavor="Your feline agility helps you inflict a devastating blow at the end of a charge." benefit="Whenever you use the ‹rule/charge› action, you gain a +1 trait bonus on your weapon damage roll."}

lycanthropic_bloodlust.name: Lycanthropic Bloodlust
description: ::trait{title="&L&Lycanthropic Bloodlust&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Werewolf-kin" flavor="When your lycanthropic heritage awakened, you thrilled at any excuse for violence. Although you might have learned to focus or suppress this urge, it still gives you energy in a fight." benefit="Once per day, when you deal damage to a foe with a natural attack, you may gain 1d6 ‹rule/temporary hit points› as an @HLimmediate_action. These temporary hit points last for 1 minute."}

shared_curse.name: Shared Curse
description: ::trait{title="&L&Shared Curse&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Skinwalker›; Werewolf-kin" flavor="A portion of your ancestor's fell curse still courses through your blood." benefit="Once per day as a @HLstandard_action, you can share a portion of your accursed heritage with a willing ally by dealing 1 point of damage to that ally with a natural weapon. The ally gains a natural bite attack, as if from your skinwalker ability, for 2 rounds."}

aerial_harrier.name: Aerial Harrier
description: ::trait{title="&L&Aerial Harrier&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Strix›" flavor="You are used to fighting enemies who cannot fly." benefit="While flying, you gain a +1 trait bonus to AC against melee attacks from creatures on the ground."}

dowsing.name: Dowsing
description: ::trait{title="&L&Dowsing&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Suli›" flavor="You are sensitive to the presence of all elements, allowing you to find water, landmarks, and evidence of prior camps or settlements." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Survival› checks. Whenever you succeed at a Survival check to follow tracks in desert terrain, you can always tell how long ago the tracks were made (though supernatural abilities and spells still impede this ability as appropriate)."}

dualborn.name: Dualborn
description: ::trait{title="&L&Dualborn&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Suli›" flavor="You were not born of a janni - your non-human heritage can instead be traced back to some dualistic power between elemental realms." benefit="Choose two energy types other than sonic (acid, cold, electricity, or fire). Once made, this choice cannot be changed. You gain racial energy resistance only to the energy types you choose, and not to others. When using your *elemental assault* ability, you can only sheath your arms in the energy types selected, but you can choose to sheath your primary hand with one of the selected energy types and your off-hand with the other. Attacks made with each hand (or a weapon held in each hand) deal bonus energy damage of the selected type. While wielding a two-handed weapon, half of the bonus energy damage is one energy type and half is the other."}

elemental_caller.name: Elemental Caller
description: ::trait{title="&L&Elemental Caller&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Suli›" flavor="You learned conjuration magic in close contact with friendly elemental beings." benefit="Treat your caster level as 1 higher to determine the duration of spells you cast that call or summon genies or outsiders with the elemental subtype."}

instant_friendship.name: Instant Friendship
description: ::trait{title="&L&Instant Friendship&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Suli›" flavor="You inherited your janni parent's knack for reversing a tense situation." benefit="Once per day, you can treat an ‹skill/Intimidate› roll to improve a creature's attitude toward you as if you had used ‹skill/Diplomacy› instead. You must use this ability after making the check but before the GM has revealed the result. If you continue threatening the target after making the check, the check automatically fails."}

practiced_impression.name: Practiced Impression
description: ::trait{title="&L&Practiced Impression&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Suli›" flavor="You traveled constantly in your youth, and were forced to practice making a good first impression until you could do so effortlessly." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks made against NPCs whom you have known for less than 1 hour."}

secret_keeper_svirfneblin.name: Secret-Keeper (Svirfneblin)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Secret-Keeper (Svirfneblin)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Svirfneblin›" flavor="You trained from birth to never reveal secrets and never betray anyone's trust." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on saving throws against divinations or enchantments that would compel you to reveal a secret or allow anyone to read your mind."}

aerial_observer.name: Aerial Observer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Aerial Observer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Sylph›" flavor="You are practiced at noticing details from high up." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Perception› checks while you are at least 30 feet above ground level."}

carrying_voice.name: Carrying Voice
description: ::trait{title="&L&Carrying Voice&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Sylph›" flavor="You grew up amid powerful storms and mimicked the rolling thunder with your voice." benefit="Treat your caster level as 2 higher to determine the range of sonic spells and effects. Others do not suffer a penalty on ‹skill/Perception› checks to hear your voice due to wind."}

following_breeze.name: Following Breeze
description: ::trait{title="&L&Following Breeze&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Sylph›" flavor="You always seem to be chased by drafts of moving air, and know exactly the right moment and method to lift yourself upon the breezes." benefit="As long as you get a running start, you gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Acrobatics› checks made to jump. Your speed increases by 5 feet when you use the ‹rule/run› action."}

thunderborn.name: Thunderborn
description: ::trait{title="&L&Thunderborn&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Sylph›" flavor="The rumble in your voice and the spark in your eyes hint at a lineage of lightning and thunder, possibly tracing back to lightning elementals from the Plane of Air, or else to a magic-touched birth during a powerful thunderstorm." benefit="Once per day when you cast a spell that deals electricity damage, you can choose to make half of the damage electricity damage and the other half sonic damage."}

wind_carried_voices.name: Wind-Carried Voices
description: ::trait{title="&L&Wind-Carried Voices&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Sylph›" flavor="You are a master of seeing through falsehoods and sharing secrets - the wind itself seems to carry your voice to those you trust." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Sense Motive› checks to tell when someone is lying to you.~~~Additionally, at will, as long as you are outdoors or in an area where there is noticeable air movement, you can whisper to any creature from up to 30 feet away. You can only designate one person in sight to hear your voice, and nearby creatures can hear these messages with a successful DC 20 ‹skill/Perception› check. This is an extraordinary ability that otherwise functions as message."}

winged_aloofness.name: Winged Aloofness
description: ::trait{title="&L&Winged Aloofness&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Syrinx›" flavor="You learned from your syrinx elders that your race is better than non-winged races and you take care to keep above them physically as well." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Fly› checks. This bonus increases to +4 on checks to avoid losing altitude when damaged."}

seafaring_slayer.name: Seafaring Slayer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Seafaring Slayer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tengu›" flavor="At a vulnerable age, you survived an encounter with a monstrous sea creature." benefit="You reduce any foe's ‹rule/cover› bonus to AC from water by 2."}

anticipate_evil.name: Anticipate Evil
description: ::trait{title="&L&Anticipate Evil&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="You can read subtle clues in the body language of fiends, allowing you to react just a bit faster than normal when dealing with such beings." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on opposed Dexterity-based skill checks against outsiders with the evil subtype. In addition, when your initiative is tied with such creatures, you always act first regardless of which of you has a higher initiative modifier."}

beast_bully.name: Beast Bully
description: ::trait{title="&L&Beast Bully&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="You have learned how to exploit the fear felt by creatures of the natural world when they sense the shadow in your soul." benefit="You can make an ‹skill/Intimidate› check instead of a ‹skill/Handle Animal› check when trying to handle or push an animal."}

blessing_of_darkness.name: Blessing of Darkness
description: ::trait{title="&L&Blessing of Darkness&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="Your innate connection with the powers of darkness serves you well when evil zealots pray on your behalf." benefit="Whenever a spellcaster capable of channeling negative energy casts a beneficial spell on you, she acts as if she were one level higher for the purpose of determining that spell's effects."}

born_damned.name: Born Damned
description: ::trait{title="&L&Born Damned&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="The inherent sacrilege that taints your soul sometimes crowds out lesser banes." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on saving throws against curses and magical effects that produce curses."}

dark_magic_affinity.name: Dark Magic Affinity
description: ::trait{title="&L&Dark Magic Affinity&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="You have an instinctive talent for unleashing the vilest spells, letting the taint in your blood empower your malicious magic." benefit="Whenever you cast a spell with the evil descriptor, you act as if you were one level higher for the purpose of determining that spell's effects."}

enduring_heritage.name: Enduring Heritage
description: ::trait{title="&L&Enduring Heritage&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" benefit="You can channel your evil ancestry to take advantage of any effects for which such an identity would matter (such as ‹spell/detect evil›). You detect as an evil outsider with the same number of HD as you possess. You can begin or end this effect as a @HLswift_action. You can maintain this effect for a number of rounds per day equal to your HD."}

ever_wary.name: Ever Wary
description: ::trait{title="&L&Ever Wary&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="Constant fear that your fiendish nature might provoke a sudden attack ensures that you never completely let down your guard." benefit="During the surprise round and before your first action in combat, you can apply half your Dexterity bonus (if any) to your AC. You still count as ‹rule/flat-footed› for the purposes of attacks and effects."}

family_connections.name: Family Connections
description: ::trait{title="&L&Family Connections&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="Your dark ancestry gives you a special insight into how to motivate or placate fiends and their kin." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks made against outsiders belonging to the evil subtype."}

fiendish_sniper.name: Fiendish Sniper
description: ::trait{title="&L&Fiendish Sniper&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="You instinctively hide after you shoot your opponents, waiting for an opportune moment to strike again." benefit="You gain a +5 trait bonus on ‹skill/Stealth› checks following a sniping attack."}

friendless.name: Friendless
description: ::trait{title="&L&Friendless&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="You have grown used to looking after yourself without help." benefit="You can make ‹skill/Heal› checks on yourself for the purposes of treating deadly wounds, diseases, and poisons."}

hard_to_pin_down.name: Hard to Pin Down
description: ::trait{title="&L&Hard to Pin Down&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="Only more pressing dangers kept bullies from victimizing you." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity made by opponents whom you ‹rule/flank› and opponents denied their Dexterity bonus to AC against you."}

inciter_tiefling.name: Inciter (Tiefling)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Inciter (Tiefling)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="You always seem to know the perfect words to sow discord." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› checks made to convince creatures to attack each other."}

malign_instrument.name: Malign Instrument
description: ::trait{title="&L&Malign Instrument&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" benefit="Select a good-aligned deity. Add 1 to the DCs of your spells' saves when targeting a good-aligned outsider or divine spellcaster who serves that deity."}

motherless.name: Motherless
description: ::trait{title="&L&Motherless&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="Your birth killed your mother, and you learned, even before words, how to manipulate others into looking after you." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Disguise› checks made for the purpose of making you seem injured, sickly, or weak in some other way."}

neutralizing_gut.name: Neutralizing Gut
description: ::trait{title="&L&Neutralizing Gut&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="Your fiendish heritage has made you more resilient to the many poisonous threats in wastelands." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on saving throws against contact and inhaled poisons, and a +3 trait bonus on saving throws against ingested poisons."}

persecuted_expatriate.name: Persecuted Expatriate
description: ::trait{title="&L&Persecuted Expatriate&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="You were born in a nation that persecuted you for your heritage. Although you were under terrible duress, you escaped either with the aid of family or by your own cunning." benefit="You gain a +1 bonus on one skill depending on your fiendish heritage: asura (‹skill/Knowledge (local)›), daemon (‹skill/Sleight of Hand›), demodand (‹skill/Intimidate›), demon (‹skill/Perception›), devil (‹skill/Sense Motive›), div (‹skill/Diplomacy›), kyton (‹skill/Escape Artist›), oni (‹skill/Disguise›), qlippoth (‹skill/Survival›), or rakshasa (Sense Motive). That skill is always a class skill for you."}

prideful_temper.name: Prideful Temper
description: ::trait{title="&L&Prideful Temper&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="Memories of the cruel abuse and taunts you suffered as a child cause you to strike back with great fury at anyone who slanders you." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on attack rolls made against creatures that have insulted you until you actually succeed in dealing damage."}

prolong_magic.name: Prolong Magic
description: ::trait{title="&L&Prolong Magic&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="Constant drills and preparation allow you to get more out of your innate magic." benefit="Whenever you use a spell-like ability gained through your tiefling heritage, it automatically acts as if affected by the ‹feat/Extend Spell› metamagic feat."}

shadow_stabber.name: Shadow Stabber
