description: ::trait{title="&L&Shadow Stabber&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="An instinct for dishonorable conduct serves you well when fighting opponents who are blind, oblivious, or blundering around in the dark." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on melee weapon damage rolls made against foes that cannot see you."}

suicidal.name: Suicidal
description: ::trait{title="&L&Suicidal&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="Shame and horror fill your subconscious, and you never stop looking for ways to grant yourself the peace of the grave." benefit="Once per day, as an @HLimmediate_action, you can make yourself the target of any attack originally directed against a creature occupying an adjacent square."}

tempters_tongue.name: Tempter's Tongue
description: ::trait{title="&L&Tempter's Tongue&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="The blood of crafty, bargain-making fiends runs in your veins, and you have a talent for brokering deals of your own." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks and on opposed Charisma checks to influence creatures you have charmed (such as with ‹spell/charm person›)."}

twilight_zeal.name: Twilight Zeal
description: ::trait{title="&L&Twilight Zeal&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="The gloom of night and of the places beyond the reach of the sun gives you comfort and courage." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on Will saving throws when in ‹rule/dim light› or darkness."}

underling.name: Underling
description: ::trait{title="&L&Underling&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›" flavor="People tend to assume you either are, or are willing to become, a minor cog in some evil cabal or conspiracy." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks made to either join or imply that you already belong to an evil organization."}

bent_body.name: Bent Body
description: ::trait{title="&L&Bent Body&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Beastbrood" flavor="While nothing is actually reversed, your bones and limbs are slightly out of alignment." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus to CMD when resisting ‹rule/grapple› attempts."}

tough_skin.name: Tough Skin
description: ::trait{title="&L&Tough Skin&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Beastbrood" flavor="You retain a small amount of your ancestors' unyielding skin." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus to AC when opponents attempt to confirm critical hits with either bludgeoning or slashing weapons."}

arms_master.name: Arms Master
description: ::trait{title="&L&Arms Master&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Faultspawn" flavor="The legendary battle prowess of your ancestors ensures that you have a certain amount of innate martial skill." benefit="You take a -2 penalty on attack rolls made with weapons with which you are not proficient instead of the normal -4."}

prayer_breaker.name: Prayer Breaker
description: ::trait{title="&L&Prayer Breaker&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Faultspawn" flavor="You have an instinctive flair for causing such pain to the faithful that they temporarily lose their connection with their god." benefit="If a divine spellcaster makes a ‹rule/concentration› check to avoid losing a spell because of an injury you caused, increase the DC of that check by +2."}

god_scorn.name: God Scorn
description: ::trait{title="&L&God Scorn&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Foulspawn" flavor="Your contempt for the gods and their sad little priests makes it easier to shake off the effects of their prayers." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against divine spells."}

repulsive.name: Repulsive
description: ::trait{title="&L&Repulsive&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Foulspawn" flavor="Your repulsiveness causes people to almost instinctively shy away from making physical contact with you." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on combat maneuver checks made to ‹rule/overrun› and ‹rule/reposition› opponents."}

deaths_deputy.name: Death's Deputy
description: ::trait{title="&L&Death's Deputy&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Grimspawn" flavor="When you send opponents to death's door, you often hurl their corpses right across its threshold." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on the damage dealt for any attack that would already reduce your target to negative hit points without this trait."}

soul_eater.name: Soul Eater
description: ::trait{title="&L&Soul Eater&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Grimspawn" flavor="The act of murder allows you to draw vitality from fleeing souls." benefit="Whenever you use a ‹misc/coup de grace› action to kill a creature (either by damage or through a failed Fortitude save), you gain a number of ‹rule/temporary hit points› equal to half your character level (minimum 1) for 1 minute. These temporary hit points do not stack with multiple *coups de grace.*"}

blood_stalker.name: Blood Stalker
description: ::trait{title="&L&Blood Stalker&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Hellspawn" flavor="Some infernal instinct makes it much easier for you to locate creatures whose blood you have drawn." benefit="You gain a +4 trait bonus on ‹skill/Survival› checks made to track or follow a trail so long as you have dealt damage to the creature you are hunting within the last week."}

unearth_secrets.name: Unearth Secrets
description: ::trait{title="&L&Unearth Secrets&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Hellspawn" flavor="You have a gift for recognizing secret desires." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Sense Motive› checks when trying to get a hunch that might reveal a target's hidden vice, dark impulse, or any other craving it would not want publicly revealed."}

big_boned.name: Big Boned
description: ::trait{title="&L&Big Boned&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Hungerseed" flavor="Your ancestors' great size has gifted you with an exceptionally sturdy frame." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on combat maneuver checks made to ‹rule/overrun› opponents, as well as a +1 trait bonus to your CMD against ‹rule/trip› attempts."}

superior_clutch.name: Superior Clutch
description: ::trait{title="&L&Superior Clutch&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Hungerseed" flavor="Your hands not only are bigger than normal, but also have a strong grip useful for wielding large weapons." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on damage rolls when using weapons intended for creatures of a larger size."}

deadly_rush.name: Deadly Rush
description: ::trait{title="&L&Deadly Rush&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Pitborn" flavor="When you hurl yourself against a foe with reckless abandon, you often land particularly telling blows." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls made as part of a ‹rule/charge›."}

flair_for_destruction.name: Flair for Destruction
description: ::trait{title="&L&Flair for Destruction&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Pitborn" flavor="You have a talent for striking objects at their weakest points." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on weapon damage rolls made against objects and constructs."}

chain_master.name: Chain Master
description: ::trait{title="&L&Chain Master&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Shackleborn" flavor="Your fiendish ancestry has granted you unnatural skill with the chain, and your enemies know to stay away when you wield it as a weapon." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on combat maneuver checks made to ‹rule/trip› opponents with a ‹eq-weapon/spiked chain› or ‹eq-weapon/whip›."}

pain_artist.name: Pain Artist
description: ::trait{title="&L&Pain Artist&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Shackleborn" flavor="Some trace of your kyton heritage makes people realize you are capable of anything, especially when they are bound and at your mercy." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Intimidate› checks made against ‹misc/helpless› creatures."}

buried_anxiety.name: Buried Anxiety
description: ::trait{title="&L&Buried Anxiety&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Spitespawn" benefit="You laugh at what makes others tremble, but are secretly disturbed by a particular sort of mundane item. Pick a specific sort of object, color, sound, or similar relatively common phenomena. You gain a +2 trait bonus on saving throws made to resist fear effects except when you can see, hear, smell, or taste that which unnerves you."}

shift_the_blame.name: Shift the Blame
description: ::trait{title="&L&Shift the Blame&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; Spitespawn" flavor="You have learned many tricks to keep yourself from facing the consequences of your misdeeds." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks made to convince someone that another person is actually at fault for your actions."}

repel_sin.name: Repel Sin
description: ::trait{title="&L&Repel Sin&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; The Motherless" flavor="You have an instinctive revulsion for the sins that led to the rise of demons and subsequent downfall of qlippoth." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on saving throws made against spells and effects with the evil descriptor."}

vile_kiss.name: Vile Kiss
description: ::trait{title="&L&Vile Kiss&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Tiefling›; The Motherless" flavor="You have learned how to exploit the natural disgust you provoke when in close proximity to others." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on combat maneuver checks to perform a ‹rule/dirty trick› combat maneuver for the purpose of making your opponent ‹misc/sickened›."}

dragon_friend.name: Dragon Friend
description: ::trait{title="&L&Dragon Friend&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Triaxian›" flavor="You know how dragons move and how they perceive body language." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus to your CMD against dragons, and whenever you encounter a particular dragon for the first time, you can make a ‹skill/Diplomacy› check to improve its attitude toward you by a maximum of one step as a @HLfull-round_action as long as you have not acted in a hostile manner toward it."}

transitional.name: Transitional
description: ::trait{title="&L&Transitional&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Triaxian›" flavor="As a Transitional Triaxian, you are attuned to the weather no matter what world you stand upon." benefit="Once per day when you attempt a ‹skill/Survival› check to predict the weather, you can add a trait bonus equal to 3 + 1/2 your character level. In addition, you gain a +1 trait bonus on Fortitude saves against the effects of cold and hot weather."}

triaxian_dragonslayer.name: Triaxian Dragonslayer
description: ::trait{title="&L&Triaxian Dragonslayer&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Triaxian›" benefit="You receive a +2 trait bonus on saving throws against the spells and spell-like abilities of dragons and a +1 trait bonus on caster level checks to overcome dragons' spell resistance."}

magic_survivor.name: Magic Survivor
description: ::trait{title="&L&Magic Survivor&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Trox›" flavor="You fought off devious magic in order to escape duergar captors." benefit="Choose two of Fortitude, Reflex, or Will saves. You gain a +1 trait bonus on saves of the types you chose against spells and spell-like abilities, and you take a -1 penalty on all saves of the remaining type."}

marids_fury.name: Marid's Fury
description: ::trait{title="&L&Marid's Fury&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Undine›" flavor="Your marid ancestry is particularly strong, and magic runs thick through your veins." benefit="When you use your ‹spell/hydraulic push› spell-like ability, it can extinguish magical fires as well as nonmagical fires as long as you succeed at an opposed caster level check (the DC is equal to 11 + the magical fire's caster level)."}

slippery_step.name: Slippery Step
description: ::trait{title="&L&Slippery Step&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Undine›" flavor="You are used to walking on wet and slippery surfaces." benefit="You are always considered to have firm footing when ‹rule/fighting underwater›, and you gain a +2 trait bonus on ‹skill/Acrobatics› checks and ‹skill/Climb› checks on wet surfaces or in wet terrain, including bogs, standing or running water, or a storm-tossed ship."}

undine_loyalty.name: Undine Loyalty
description: ::trait{title="&L&Undine Loyalty&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Undine›" flavor="You learned early on that teamwork can help keep you safe from troublemakers." benefit="Choose one ‹main/teamwork feat› that requires an ally with the same feat to be adjacent to you. You may benefit from that teamwork feat as long as you have an ally within 10 feet of you (though your ally does not benefit from the teamwork feat unless it also has this trait or a similar ability)."}

water_shaping.name: Water Shaping
description: ::trait{title="&L&Water Shaping&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Undine›" flavor="Your tight-knit undine community helped you practice your water magic safely." benefit="Whenever you cast a spell or use a spell-like ability that has the cold or water descriptor and affects an area, you can choose one square within the area. The spell or spell-like ability does not affect that square or creatures in it."}

whiteout.name: Whiteout
description: ::trait{title="&L&Whiteout&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Undine›" flavor="When the air is full of water, your elemental blood allows you to blend with your surroundings and become one with the precipitation." benefit="In areas of nonmagical fog, rain, snow, or similar conditions (such as the spray of a waterfall), you gain the effects of ‹rule/concealment›, but with a miss chance of 10%. If the precipitation would already grant you concealment, the miss chances stack."}

calculated_risk.name: Calculated Risk
description: ::trait{title="&L&Calculated Risk&FN&" type="Race" req="Vampire; Jiang-shi" benefit="Once per day, you may voluntarily fail a saving throw against a harmful spell or effect. After using this ability, for the next minute you may add a +4 trait bonus on one saving throw, after which the bonus is expended. You may use this bonus on an additional saving throw against the spell or effect you voluntarily failed (such as a recurring poison save or a follow-up save against hold person). If you do not use this bonus within 1 minute, it is lost."}

in_tune_with_language.name: In Tune with Language
description: ::trait{title="&L&In Tune with Language&FN&" type="Race" req="Vampire; Jiang-shi" benefit="Your keen ear for language grants you a +2 trait bonus on skill checks when decoding secret messages or finding hidden meaning in overheard conversations."}

proud_progenitor.name: Proud Progenitor
description: ::trait{title="&L&Proud Progenitor&FN&" type="Race" req="Vampire; Moroi" flavor="Your loneliness drove you to build your coven, and you zealously attack any who would harm it." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on damage rolls against creatures you have seen attack or harm any of your vampire spawn."}

weatherworn.name: Weatherworn
description: ::trait{title="&L&Weatherworn&FN&" type="Race" req="Vampire; Moroi" flavor="Lairing in desolate mountains or on coastal cliff tops has taught you to deal with the effects of strong winds." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus against the effects of spells that create wind or move air, such as ‹spell/gust of wind›. You treat natural ‹rule/weather› conditions as one step weaker. These abilities also apply when you are in gaseous form."}

rapid_drain.name: Rapid Drain
description: ::trait{title="&L&Rapid Drain&FN&" type="Race" req="Vampire; Nosferatu" flavor="The ferocity of your hunger grants you the ability to draw life from your victims faster." benefit="When you use your *blood drain* ability, you gain 7 temporary hit points instead of 5."}

telekinetic_dependence.name: Telekinetic Dependence
description: ::trait{title="&L&Telekinetic Dependence&FN&" type="Race" req="Vampire; Nosferatu" flavor="Your body is so ancient you fear damaging it with exertion." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus to your caster level when casting (or using as a spell-like ability) ‹spell/fly›, ‹spell/levitate›, ‹spell/mage hand›, ‹spell/telekinesis›, and similar spells that move objects through sheer will."}

self_aware.name: Self-Aware
description: ::trait{title="&L&Self-Aware&FN&" type="Race" req="Vampire; Vetala" flavor="Wisdom stolen from an enlightened mortal has opened your own mind. Knowing yourself helps you to understand others." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on all ‹skill/Sense Motive› checks, and Sense Motive becomes a class skill for you."}

stubborn.name: Stubborn
description: ::trait{title="&L&Stubborn&FN&" type="Race" req="Vampire; Vetala" flavor="The angry child inside bolsters your will, and you often prove utterly defiant." benefit="You gain a +2 trait bonus on saving throws against attempts to control you, such as ‹spell/command undead›, ‹spell/halt undead›, or ‹ability/channel«ed» energy› to turn or control undead."}

trickster_vanara.name: Trickster (Vanara)
description: ::trait{title="&L&Trickster (Vanara)&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Vanara›" flavor="You learned early that in order to get what you want, sometimes you have to act secretly." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Stealth› checks, and one of these skills (your choice) is always a class skill for you."}

augmented_spell_poisons.name: Augmented Spell Poisons
description: ::trait{title="&L&Augmented Spell Poisons&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Vishkanya›" flavor="You can use your natural poison to augment the spells you cast." benefit="You can spend a use of your *toxic* racial trait and use a bit of your toxic saliva or blood as an additional material component for a spell with the poison descriptor to increase the spell's save DC by 1."}

water_lurker.name: Water Lurker
description: ::trait{title="&L&Water Lurker&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Wayang›" flavor="You grew up in a secretive community by the water, perhaps among the rivers of Shenmen or the islands of Minata." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Swim› checks and a +2 bonus on ‹skill/Stealth› checks on watercraft and when at least half-submerged in water."}

resilient_construction.name: Resilient Construction
description: ::trait{title="&L&Resilient Construction&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Wyrwood›" flavor="You spent a great deal of time around magical workshops, and the power of magic sustains you." benefit="Once per day, if you would be reduced to 0 or fewer hit points while under the effects of an ongoing spell you cast with a range of personal, you are not destroyed by the attack, but instead become inactive and helpless for 1 round, at negative hit points. If you take damage again during that time, or if you are still below 0 hit points at the end of that round, you are destroyed."}

fierce_flanker.name: Fierce Flanker
description: ::trait{title="&L&Fierce Flanker&FN&" type="Race" req="‹race/Wyvaran›" flavor="You were bullied in your youth but supported by one or more good friends, impressing upon you the importance of teamwork." benefit="You gain a +1 trait bonus on damage rolls against foes you ‹rule/flank›."}

blood_of_dragons.name: Blood of Dragons
description: ::trait{title="&L&Blood of Dragons&FN&" type="Race" flavor="Long ago, your ancestors' blood mixed with that of dragons." benefit="Choose one of the following: gain a +1 trait bonus on ‹skill/Perception› checks, gain low-light vision, or gain a +2 trait bonus on saving throws against effects that cause sleep or paralysis."}

deathtouched.name: Deathtouched
description: ::trait{title="&L&Deathtouched&FN&" type="Race" req="Any" flavor="At some point you were tainted with the corruption of the undead, and you have gained some of their defenses." benefit="You gain either a +1 trait bonus on Fortitude saving throws or a +2 trait bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects (your choice)."}

draconic_lineage.name: Draconic Lineage
description: ::trait{title="&L&Draconic Lineage&FN&" type="Race" benefit="Somewhere in your family line, draconic power entered your bloodline. As a result of this lineage, you gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against fear and against any effect created by a creature of the dragon type. If you gain a bloodrager or sorcerer bloodline, you must choose *draconic.*"}

fiend_blood.name: Fiend Blood
description: ::trait{title="&L&Fiend Blood&FN&" type="Race" req="Any" flavor="The blood of fiends taints your line, manifesting physically, though it may be barely noticeable." benefit="Choose one of the following skills: ‹skill/Bluff›, ‹skill/Intimidate›, or ‹skill/Knowledge (planes)›. You gain a +1 trait bonus on checks with that skill, and it is always a class skill for you."}
